title: Accountant
description:
**About Us**

Founded in 2019, LEOR is a premium skin, hair and body clinic in Pune, with centres in Koregaon Park and Aundh. We believe beauty lies in the radiance, not in fairness and that the smallest details shape the experience. Every treatment is delivered with world-class technology and highly-skilled doctors, uncompromising on quality and safety. We are now looking for an exceptional accountant to join us.

**About The Role**

As an Accountant at LEOR, you will own the books for both centres and keep the numbers clean, current and compliant. You will close the month on time, keep every statutory filing in order, and give the management team figures they can act on without second-guessing them.

Job Title: Accountant

Location: Pune (covering Koregaon Park and Aundh)

Employment Type: Full-time

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Accounting and Reconciliation**

* Maintain complete books of accounts in Tally for the entity, covering both centres.
* Reconcile daily collections from the clinic software against bank, card and payment gateway settlements.
* Record and verify purchases, vendor bills, petty cash and employee reimbursements.

**2. Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns on time and reconcile input tax credit against 2A and 2B.
* Handle TDS deduction, payment and quarterly returns, along with PF, ESIC and professional tax.
* Coordinate with auditors and consultants for statutory audit, annual closing and income tax filings.

**3. Payables, Receivables and Payroll**

* Process vendor payments on schedule and maintain a clean ageing.
* Track outstanding client payments and package dues with the centre teams.
* Prepare monthly payroll including incentives, and ensure accurate and timely disbursal.

**4. Reporting and Controls**

* Publish the monthly P&L and centre-wise revenue and expense reports within the closing calendar.
* Maintain the fixed asset register and reconcile consumables and inventory with the centres.
* Flag variances, leakages and process gaps, and follow them through to correction.

**Qualifications**

* B.Com or M.Com from a recognised institution. CA Inter or CMA Inter is an advantage.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on accounting experience, preferably in a multi-location retail, healthcare or clinic environment.

**Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of Tally and advanced Excel.
* Practical command of GST, TDS and payroll statutory compliance.
* Ability to reconcile clinic or POS software data against the books.
* Accuracy, discretion with confidential information, and the discipline to close on time every month.

**Why LEOR Clinic**

* A fast-growing premium brand where finance has visibility across the whole business.
* Clean systems and structured reporting, not firefighting.
* Direct exposure to management and a seat in the decisions the numbers drive.
* A workplace built around quality, where every detail is considered.

**How to Apply:**

* Send your CV to the LEOR Clinic team for review at hr@leorclinic.com

title: Accountant – P&L, MIS & Finance Control
description:
**Company:**

Living Timeless

**Location:**

Pune

**Industry:**

Modular Furniture / Interior Manufacturing

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

Living Timeless is looking for a commercially strong
**Accountant / Finance Executive**

who can manage core accounting while also owning
**P&L visibility, MIS, project profitability, cash flow, receivables, payables, and cost control**

.

This is not a pure bookkeeping role. We need someone who can convert accounting data into clear financial insights for management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain complete and accurate books of accounts
* Prepare and review
  **monthly P&L statements**
* Build
  **project-wise and showroom-wise P&L**
* Track revenue, COGS, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and profitability
* Analyse
  **budget vs actual performance**
* Identify margin leakage, cost overruns and unusual expenses
* Track project-level:
* Revenue booked
* Collections
* Material cost
* Manufacturing cost
* Installation cost
* Logistics
* Discounts
* Rework / snag costs
* Gross profit
* Contribution margin
* Prepare weekly and monthly
  **management MIS**
* Maintain cash-flow forecasts and upcoming payment requirements
* Track customer receivables and ageing
* Track vendor payables and payment schedules
* Monitor purchase advances and vendor reconciliations
* Perform bank reconciliations
* Manage GST, TDS and statutory accounting requirements
* Coordinate with CA and auditors
* Verify purchase invoices, POs and payment approvals
* Track factory, showroom and corporate overheads separately
* Maintain machinery, fixed-asset and capex accounting
* Support payroll, incentives and reimbursements
* Develop financial controls to prevent duplicate, incorrect or unauthorized payments

**P&L Ownership**

The person should be comfortable preparing and explaining:

**Revenue**

Less: Material / Procurement Cost

Less: Manufacturing Cost

Less: Installation & Logistics

=
**Gross Profit**

Less: Sales & Marketing

Less: Showroom Expenses

Less: Factory Overheads

Less: Salaries & Admin

=
**EBITDA**

They should be able to clearly explain
**why profitability moved month-on-month**

, not simply produce the report.

**Management Reporting**

Expected reporting should include:

* Monthly consolidated P&L
* Project-wise profitability
* Showroom-wise profitability
* Factory cost report
* Gross-margin trends
* Marketing spend vs revenue
* Payroll as % of revenue
* Fixed vs variable costs
* Receivable ageing
* Payable ageing
* Cash-flow forecast
* Budget vs actual
* Capex tracker
* Revenue booked vs revenue collected
* Upcoming financial liabilities

**What We Expect**

We want someone who proactively flags:

“Gross margin has dropped from 42% to 35% this month.”

“This project has exceeded its installation budget.”

“Material cost on this category is running above target.”

“₹X is receivable but overdue.”

“Factory overhead has increased faster than revenue.”

“This showroom is generating revenue but is not yet contribution-positive.”

“Based on upcoming vendor payments and collections, we will require ₹X cash over the next 30 days.”

**Candidate Profile**

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance / equivalent
* 3–6+ years of relevant experience
* Strong understanding of
  **P&L, MIS, cost accounting and financial analysis**
* Strong Excel skills
* Experience with Tally / ERP systems
* Strong understanding of GST and TDS
* Experience in
  **manufacturing, furniture, interiors, construction or project-based businesses preferred**
* Comfortable working directly with founders and senior management
* Strong attention to detail with a commercial mindset

﻿

**Most Important Trait**

We are not looking for someone who only asks:

**“Has this invoice been entered?”**

We want someone who also asks:

**“Why did we spend this money, which project does it belong to, what margin are we making, and what does this do to the P&L?”**

title: Senior Analyst, Finance Solutions

**What We Offer**

As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. **Group Summary**
Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
This position needs an analytical, well-educated, knowledgeable, and motivated team-player with strong FICO (Finance and Controlling) background, work ethic and integrity that will become a key part of “Global IT” to implement and provide adequate, 24x7 support for FICO (Finance and Controlling).
  
  
Providing daily support to Magna divisions/plants, especially Americas region. Needs to discuss with users, host workshops, define optional solutions, and be able to initiate FICO improvement projects, implement it, and manage project status/schedule is also required.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Analyze business requirements and gaps not met by the existing systems / implementations.
* Identify feasible solutions within SAP framework and estimate effort needed to meet those business requirements and gaps.
* Implement solutions using SAP configuration, master data setup or code and support roll-out projects.
* Provide day-to-day SAP end-user support including month end closing

* Provide user training to group/divisions

* Complete other duties as required by the Manager from time to time.
* Uses teamwork to positively and effectively contribute to a high morale/high-performance team culture, consulting attitude and strong personal integrity.
* He/she ensures global support.
* Perform a complete, detailed analysis evaluating available applications and identifying opportunities for enhancing existing systems.
* Assist in the coordination and collaboration of external consultants (Customer & Suppliers) as well as internal team members.
* Time tracking and documentation according to Magna Global IT standards
* Ensures billing of his/her projects and changes
* Design practical, creative, conceptual technical solutions for business requirements balancing appropriate technology, cost and implementation timeline.
* Develop and adhere to standards for design, coding, testing, change control, code deployment, software controls, configuration management, continuous integration, and troubleshooting and root cause analysis of application problems.
* Maintain documentation of invoice processing procedures and support activities.

**Performance Measures**

* Project Management (In time, in quality, In budget) proper documentation and reporting.
* SLA (Service level Agreement) fulfillment to the divisions.
* Less problems and escalations.
* Project time should be more than 30%.
* Support new SAP Implementations.

**Knowledge and Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or similar discipline.
* Must be able to communicate in English.
* Experience in Automotive Industry is preferred.

**Work Experience**

* More than 4 years of SAP FICO-related experience.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Experience of SAP full cycle project as a FICO consultant
* Basic finance and controlling concepts knowledge are must
* Familiar with finance accounting submodules, have experience of data migration methodology, such as fixed asset migration, G/L master data migration, and inventory migration, etc.
* Able to configure and support FICO module in SAP.
* Familiar with FICO integration with other SAP modules such as material management, sales and distribution.
* Experience of FICO validation and substitution or enhancements is required.
* Payment interface with bank is desired.
* Material Ledger and Project Systems skill will be a plus.
* ABAP debug skill is a plus.
* Review and work up development requests & specs for ABAP programmers to develop customized functionality or reports to meet business requirements.
* Knowledge of Business Warehouse (BW) is preferred.
* Analytical and flexible approaches in the projects and coordination of available resources.
* Excellent performance and organizational skills.
* Must be able to work independently as well as a team player and can manage own workload.
* Able to collaborate with users and have a strong desire to host workshops.
* Good communication and customer service skills

**Work Environment**

* Constant sitting, standing and walking and occasional lifting/moving and bending
* Constant manual dexterity, audio attention and visual attention
* Most of the job is performed in a standard office environment with minimal risk or harmful elements

Regular overnight travel 10-25% of the time

We offer attractive benefits (e.g. employee profit participation program) and a salary which is in line with market conditions depending on your skills and experience

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. title: General Accounting Manager
description:
Unlock your potential with Dassault Systèmes, a global leader in Scientific Software Engineering as a
**General Accounting Manager in Pune, Maharashtra!**
The General Accounting Manager is responsible for managing multiple General Accounting activities for Dassault Systèmes (DS) legal entities, including Bank Reconciliation (automated and manual), VAT processes and entries, closing entries, Fixed Asset accounting, AP-to-GL reconciliation, Manual Payment Processing, Account Reconciliations, Closing Task Monitoring. The role is accountable for ensuring accurate and timely financial close, compliance with IFRS and local statutory requirements, strong internal controls, and continuous process improvement. Along with strong accounting and domain expertise, the ideal candidate will demonstrate proven capabilities in people leadership, team development, stakeholder management, and process improvement, along with hands-on experience with ERP systems such as PeopleSoft and SAP, Kyriba, and banking platforms, preferably within a Shared Services or Global Business Services environment.
  
  
**Role Description & Responsibilities:**
**R2R Operations**

* Lead and govern month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities; ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Manage bank reconciliation operations across automated and manual processes, driving exception resolution, root-cause analysis.
* Oversee ICTP (Intercompany and Transfer Pricing) activities, including intercompany accounting, transfer pricing entries, reconciliations, and resolving intercompany mismatches.
* Oversee VAT accounting and compliance, including entries, reconciliations, reporting, and coordination with tax stakeholders.
* Lead Fixed Asset accounting and governance, covering additions, depreciation, transfers, disposals, and FA-to-GL reconciliations.
* Ensure timely completion of AP-to-GL and Balance sheet account reconciliation, driving timely resolution of variances and aged items.
* Review accounting entries, including accruals, provisions, reclassifications, ICTP entries, and period-end adjustments, along with timely submission of account reconciliations.
* Oversee manual payment processes, ensuring appropriate controls, approvals, segregation of duties, and timely execution in platforms such as HSBC, Kyriba, and Global Cash.

**People Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team. Allocate work, monitor productivity, and ensure service delivery targets are achieved.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and create development plans.
* Foster employee engagement and maintain a healthy team environment.
* Drive succession planning, talent development, and attrition management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and build strong cross-functional relationships.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Process Improvement & Knowledge Management**

* Drive continuous process improvement, automation, and transformation initiatives while ensuring adherence to internal controls, company policies, and operating standards.
* Monitor KPIs and operational performance, and contribute to finance system enhancements and process optimization projects.
* Capture, document, and share best practices, process improvements, and complex case resolutions to enhance team capability and operational consistency.
* Develop and maintain accurate process documentation and SOPs, ensuring effective knowledge management and consistent execution across the team.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or related field; Finance preferred.
* 10–13+ years of Finance & Accounting experience with strong R2R/GL experience
* Prior experience managing teams in a GBS/Shared Services/MNC environment.
* Strong knowledge of GL, reconciliations, fixed assets, VAT, bank accounting, month-end close, Intercompany & Transfer Pricing and financial controls.
* Experience with SAP/Oracle or other ERP systems.

**Motivations/Interests**

* Strong people and stakeholder management skills, with excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Strong accounting knowledge
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen learning mindset, positive attitude, and strong team orientation.
* Structured, disciplined, and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional and culturally diverse teams.
* Committed to maintaining high-quality deliverables and driving quality assurance initiatives in line with operating principles.

**What is in it for you?**

* Work for the one of the biggest software companies in Europe
* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Opportunities for personal development and career progression

Inclusion statement
  
  
As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR)
description:
**About the role**

Run our international patient business at CureMeAbroad as if it were your own company. You'll own the P&L end-to-end, know the revenue, margin, and unit economics of every specialty, hospital, and source market, and act on those numbers through pricing, package design, and cost control. You'll work directly with the founding team as a thought partner on where the business goes next. This is a founder-style, business-owner role, not a process-management role.

**What you'll do**

* Own the P&L for patient services: revenue, gross and contribution margin, budgeting, and forecasting.
* Track unit economics by specialty, hospital, and source market, and turn them into decisions on pricing, packages, and cost control.
* Identify and test new growth bets, such as new specialties, packages, or source markets, and build the business case for the ones worth scaling.
* Work with the partnerships team on hospital commercial terms: rate cards, volume commitments, and quality-linked pricing.
* Work with finance on budgets, cost estimates, and monthly reporting.
* Drive patient operations and customer success outcomes (turnaround times, retention, referrals, patient satisfaction) through the ops and CS team, and stay accountable for their impact on margin.
* Flag and escalate critical and high-risk cases to the founders.
* Build dashboards and a regular business review that show where we make and lose money, and bring recommendations, not just reports, to the founding team.

**What you'll bring (must-have)**

* 4-6 years of total experience, with 2+ years owning or closely managing a P&L, business unit, or budget.
* 3+ years of full-time experience in a startup or scale-up. This is mandatory: you're comfortable with ambiguity, thin processes, and wearing multiple hats.
* An entrepreneurial track record: you've built something from scratch, launched a new line of business, or founded or co-founded a venture.
* Strong command of unit economics, margins, and forecasting, and comfort building models in Excel or Sheets.
* Ability to negotiate and structure commercial terms with external partners.
* Clear communication and comfort working with clinical, ops, finance, and partnership stakeholders across time zones.

**Good to have**

* Background in strategy, consulting, business-unit management, or finance business partnering.
* Experience in healthcare, medical travel, hospitality, or another high-touch service business.

Sr. Accountant R2R

Individual Contributor

Chinchwad, Pune

**Purpose of the role:**

The R2R Intercompany (ICP) Reconciliation Analyst is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely reconciliation of intercompany transactions and balances across group entities. The role involves maintaining the integrity of General Ledger accounts, identifying and resolving reconciliation differences, supporting month-end and year-end close activities, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across Finance, O2C, P2P, Treasury, and Business teams.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Intercompany Reconciliation & General Ledger Management
* Perform timely and accurate reconciliation of intercompany balances and transactions across legal entities.
* Monitor and maintain Intercompany (ICP) and General Ledger accounts, ensuring all transactions are recorded accurately and completely.
* Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences, mismatches, aging items, and out-of-balance conditions within agreed timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of reconciliations, supporting schedules, and exception reporting.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities related to intercompany accounting.
* Reconciliation and Issue Resolution
* Complete periodic reconciliations of assigned balance sheet and P&L accounts in compliance with company policies.
* Identify root causes of reconciling items and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely closure.
* Track open items, monitor aging, and drive resolution through regular follow-ups with counterparties and business teams.
* Prepare reconciliation reports and provide status updates to management.
* Compliance and Financial Controls
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal control requirements, company policies, and statutory regulations.
* Maintain adequate audit trails and supporting documentation for all reconciliation activities.
* Support control testing and remediation activities related to Intercompany processes.
* Audit Support
* Provide reconciliation reports, supporting schedules, transaction details, and explanations to internal and external auditors.
* Assist during statutory audits, internal audits, and corporate reviews.
* Address audit queries accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Stakeholder Management and Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Liaise with business stakeholders, finance controllers, and shared service teams to resolve intercompany discrepancies.
* Collaborate closely with O2C, P2P, Treasury, Tax, and accounting teams to resolve transaction and posting issues impacting GL and ICP accounts.
* Support management with timely financial information and analysis for decision-making.
* Participate in regular governance meetings and reconciliation review calls with global counterparts.
* Process Improvement and Continuous Excellence
* Identify opportunities to enhance reconciliation efficiency, standardization, automation, and control effectiveness.
* Drive reduction of aged reconciling items and recurring exceptions through process improvements.
* Support implementation of process optimization initiatives, system enhancements, and automation solutions.
* Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

**Academic & Work Profile:**

* CA/CA- Inter., MBA, CMA – Inter. 3 – 8 yrs. exp. in accounting
* Strong in Accounting and intercompany Reconciliation process
* Relevant Experience/ Knowledge in reputed Captive/Outsourcing RTR Ops.
* Good Written/Verbal Communication
* Ms Excel Knowledge.
* Preferred someone with exposure of SAP for 1+ years
* Stakeholder Management experience
* Quality Lean/Process Improvement knowledge

title: Sr Strategic Sourcing Spec
description:
**Job Description**
As a Sr Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) in India and EMEA or Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) categories supporting Honeywell manufacturing operations in India and partially APAC.
  
  
You will partner with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Integrated Supply Chain, Finance, and Project Management teams to deliver productivity, improve supplier performance, mitigate commercial and supply risks, and support the successful execution of capital investment and operational reliability initiatives.
  
  
You will apply your manufacturing and strategic sourcing experience to manage complex supplier engagements, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate commercial agreements, and implement category strategies that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for CAPEX / MRO categories supporting manufacturing operations
* Support the execution of capital investment projects in India and EMEA region, including manufacturing expansion, capacity growth, automation, modernization, and equipment replacement initiatives
* Lead sourcing activities related to manufacturing expansion projects in Pune and Hyderabad
* Manage end-to-end sourcing activities, including requirements review, market analysis, supplier identification, RFx execution, bid evaluation, negotiation, supplier recommendation, contracting, and implementation
* Lead sourcing activities for capital equipment, production machinery, automation systems, manufacturing technologies, installation services, commissioning support, and related technical services
* Develop and implement sourcing strategies for MRO categories, including industrial spare parts, repair and maintenance services, OEM components, industrial consumables, technical services, tools, and reliability-related requirements
* Partner with Engineering and Project Management teams to align sourcing plans with technical specifications, project schedules, budgets, and implementation requirements
* Collaborate with Operations and Maintenance teams to support equipment availability, operational continuity, and manufacturing reliability
* Drive productivity through competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, demand management, value engineering, specification optimization, supplier consolidation, and total cost of ownership analysis
* Conduct supply market analysis and supplier benchmarking to support sourcing decisions
* Monitor supplier performance across quality, delivery, cost, service, responsiveness, and compliance
* Lead supplier performance reviews and establish corrective action and continuous improvement plans as needed
* Evaluate supplier capabilities, capacity, financial health, commercial position, and supply continuity risks
* Develop and execute mitigation plans for supplier, contractual, commercial, and project-execution risks
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, payment terms, productivity commitments, warranties, service levels, liability, and other contractual requirements
* Ensure compliance with Honeywell sourcing policies, ethical requirements, approval processes, and contract governance standards
* Support contract development, execution, administration, supplier compliance, and resolution of commercial issues
* Maintain and support accurate sourcing plans, project updates, savings forecasts, supplier information, risk documentation, supporting records, annual productivity, working capital, cost optimization, and supply continuity objectives
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and gain alignment on sourcing recommendations, supplier selection, and commercial decisions
* Promote standard sourcing processes, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement across the India CAPEX and MRO portfolio

CAPEX strategy includes categories such as processing machinery, test & analytical, automation and process controls, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning), material handling, packaging and other industrial equipment, supplies & services Meanwhile, MRO strategy includes categories such as OEM spare parts, pumps, pipes, valves and fittings, motors, bearings, power transmission, pneumatics, hydraulics, hardware, fasteners, industrial gases, chemicals, lubricants, cutting tools, hand and power tools, electrical supplies, and other industrial materials.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline
* 7 to 10 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Category Management, or a related field
* Demonstrated experience working in or directly supporting a manufacturing environment
* Experience developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for CAPEX and/or MRO categories
* Experience sourcing capital equipment, production machinery, industrial equipment, maintenance services, spare parts, technical services, and/or industrial consumables
* Experience leading competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations
* Experience negotiating supplier contracts, commercial terms, payment terms, warranties, and service-level requirements
* Experience managing supplier relationships and driving supplier performance improvements
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable cost reduction, productivity, working capital, or total cost improvements
* Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, and commercial decision-making skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Finance, Integrated Supply Chain, and Project Management stakeholders
* Ability to communicate effectively in English within a global business environment

**WE VALUE**

* Engineering background combined with strategic sourcing or procurement experience
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and industrial supply markets and possessing strong project management and organizational skills
* Strong knowledge of MRO sourcing, industrial spare parts, maintenance services, OEM requirements, industrial supplies, and reliability-related procurement
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, manufacturing expansion, automation, modernization, capacity growth, or equipment replacement projects
* Experience managing sourcing activities from specification development through supplier selection, contracting, delivery, installation, commissioning support, and project closeout
* Experience applying total cost of ownership, should-cost analysis, cost modeling, value engineering, and cost-benefit analysis
* Experience using supplier scorecards, business reviews, corrective actions, and continuous improvement plans
* Knowledge of contract governance, commercial risk management, supplier compliance, and sourcing controls
* Ability to manage multiple sourcing projects and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Strong problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, as well as influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
* Experience working across global and regional teams in a matrixed organization
* Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence experience mind set
* Knowledge of eSourcing, spend analytics, contract management, and procurement systems.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Job Title: Data Engineer
  
  
Department: Service Assurance
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our Service Assurance function. This role is central to the design, development, and maintenance of our data reporting platforms, and analytical tooling. The successful candidate will combine strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to interpret data and communicate meaningful insights.
  
  
Working across our BI, Snowflake Cortex, and AI-assisted reporting environments, you will build scalable data pipelines, develop impactful dashboards and reports, and leverage tools including Claude (Anthropic) and CoPilot to enhance data interpretation and automate insight generation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain robust data analytic reports and processes to support Service Assurance reporting and analytics needs.
* Develop and publish reports and dashboards in Business Intelligence tools (e.g. Power BI, Snowflake, Tableau, or equivalent), ensuring accuracy, usability, and performance.
* Work within Snowflake Cortex to create, optimise, and manage data models, queries, and analytical workflows.
* Utilise Claude (Anthropic) and other AI-assisted tools to automate reporting, generate data summaries, and produce actionable interpretations of complex datasets.
* Write and maintain SQL scripts, Python scripts, and LLM prompts to support data extraction, transformation, and analysis tasks.
* Perform trend analysis and data storytelling, not just producing reports, but interpreting what the data means and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate business questions into data solutions.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a closely related data role (e.g. BI Developer, Analytics Engineer).
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including Snowflake Cortex for advanced analytics and AI-powered SQL functions.
* Strong proficiency in SQL — writing complex queries, optimising performance, and working with large datasets.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards in BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
* Proven experience designing and optimizing ETL pipelines and data architectures, with demonstrable focus on performance and cost efficiency.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude (Anthropic) for data interpretation, prompt engineering, and automated reporting workflows.
* Ability to write and maintain Python scripts for data processing, automation, and analysis.
* Experience creating and refining LLM prompts to extract structured insight from unstructured data or to automate narrative reporting.
* Strong analytical mindset — able to interpret what data trends and patterns mean in a business context, not just produce numbers.
* Proven ability to present data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Kyriba Implementation - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
You’ll analyze Treasury operations to design future-state models, support Kyriba solution design, and configure static data for Treasury processes. You’ll automate cash reconciliation, enable bank statement integration, set up Cash Position worksheets, and manage cash forecasting with ERP integration. Responsibilities include interfacing Kyriba with systems like ICD, FXALL, and Oracle, establishing cash pools, configuring payment workflows, and adding Chart of Accounts for accounting. You’ll also handle documentation, user guides, end-user training, and team coordination to ensure seamless Treasury operations.
  
  
**The team:**
Controllership & Treasury Transformation (C&TT) is one of the offerings within the Finance Transformation portfolio of Deloitte US India Consulting. This Offering advises, implements, and delivers solution as-a-service relating to digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, enterprise performance strategies and technologies solutions. By taking a holistic view of these key business areas from strategy development through process design and technology enablement, we help our clients navigate their challenges while continuing to succeed in their business.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Kyriba – Working knowledge of at least two Kyriba modules like Core Data, Bank and Cash, Payments, Accounting, Financial Transactions, Security. Exposure to Kyriba Connectivity, BAM and BFA would be an added advantage
* Payments formats – XML Pain, EDI822, MT101 etc.
* Bank statement formats – MT940/42, BAI, CAMT053 etc.
* A good understanding of Treasury, Cash Management, Cash Pools, Account structures, and global Payment methods
* Job skills – Interpersonal Communication, Critical Thinking, Decision Making
* Total experience of 5 to 8 years, 2+ years of experience directly in implementing Treasury management solutions (Kyriba)
* Kyriba Certification – Gold or above (Platinum, Platinum Plus)

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Big 4 experience

**Education:**

* B.Tech/CA/MBA degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata

**Shift Timings:**

* 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirement

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior, Tax Services –Tax Technology Consulting – Oracle EBS**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions. This role sits within Tax Technology Consulting and focuses on Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Financials Cloud capabilities that impact tax. You will help clients improve tax operations through process design, requirements gathering, system assessment, automation, and solution development. This is an opportunity to work on complex tax transformation initiatives in a global environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior, Tax Services on the Tax Technology Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Conduct client workshops.
* Gather and document tax requirements for the business and perform system fit-gap analysis.
* Advise clients on tax department strategy and policy, including tax assessment from a people, process, technology, and governance perspective.
* Support process improvement, tax department redesign, and evaluation of automation opportunities.
* Work on the design and development of tax solutions.
* Conduct user acceptance testing to compile test scenarios and identify flaws and improvement opportunities in newly built systems and processes.

**The team**
Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TMC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TMC group. Deloitte TMC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**

Required:
  
  

* Full-time bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounts, or equivalent from a reputed university.
* MBA or Chartered Accountant with experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Auditing.
* 4-7 years of experience with Oracle EBS finance modules or Oracle Financials Cloud modules that impact tax.
* Experience with financial consolidation processes and applications, including Hyperion applications.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access.
* Experience with Oracle modules such as E-Business Tax or Oracle ERP Cloud tax module, Trading Community Architecture, Order Management or iStore, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing or iExpense, Accounts Payable, Supplier Master or iSupplier Portal, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, General Ledger, or Oracle BI.

Preferred:
  
  

* Knowledge of business and tax processes, creating functional specifications, identifying and developing requirements for new reports, preparing test scripts, and providing user training and support.
* Experience with indirect tax, direct tax, or withholding tax.
* Knowledge of country-specific localization capabilities of Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion applications.
* Experience with third-party tax software such as Vertex, ONESOURCE, SOVOS (Taxware), or Avalara.
* Knowledge of PL/SQL.

title: Statutory Accounting Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The Statutory Accounting Sr. Analyst at NIQ will join our Global Record to Report team in Global Finance Operations. In this role, you will be instrumental in preparing statutory financial statements for NIQ operating companies and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and accounting standards. This position demands a high level of accuracy and integrity in financial reporting. As a Statutory Accounting Sr. Analyst, you will work closely with controllers and the corporate accounting function to support a critical element of our end-to-end record to report process.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Statutory Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate and timely statutory financial statements for NIQ operating companies, ensuring they comply with local and international accounting standards.

• Compliance Monitoring: Monitor and ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements related to local statutory reporting across different jurisdictions.

• Audit Support: Assist in the coordination and preparation of audit materials with all teams and work closely with auditors to facilitate the audit process.

• Corporate Law Compliances: Filing of information with local company houses in accordance with applicable corporate law

• Reconciliation and Analysis: Perform reconciliations of statutory reports to ensure they align with internal records and identify discrepancies or areas for improvement. Ensure all raised or identified points during the audit or included in management letter are resolved before the next audit commences.

• Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate with controllers and corporate accounting teams to gather information, resolve issues, and deliver high-quality financial reports.

• Process Improvement: Contribute to the improvement of statutory reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements to enhance accuracy and efficiency

**Qualifications**

• Educational Background: A qualified Chartered Accountant / CPA

• Professional Experience: Minimum 2 years’ experience in statutory accounting or in a related financial reporting role for more than one country is preferred. Familiarity with international financial reporting standards and local regulations is essential.

• Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency with ERP systems and financial reporting software. Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel are highly desirable.

• Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical skills with a focus on accuracy and detail in preparing financial statements and reports.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with and support team members across various levels and functions.

• Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational and time management skills, capable of managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines in a dynamic environment.

**Job Description – Lead Finance & Accounts**

Youthville | Pune, Maharashtra | Full-Time | 6 Days Working

Lead – Finance & Accounts

Pune, Maharashtra

6 Days Working | Work from Office

Experience: 5+ years, including leadership experience

**About Youthville**

Youthville is a hospitality and managed-living venture of the Kohinoor Group, focused on providing premium, comfortable and community-driven accommodation experiences. With an expanding presence in Pune and ambitions to grow its footprint across Pune and Mumbai, Youthville is building a scalable, professionally managed accommodation business.

At Youthville, we believe that great experiences for residents begin with strong systems, operational excellence and a committed team. As we continue to grow, we are looking for experienced finance professionals who can strengthen our financial foundation, drive process excellence and contribute to the company's long-term business growth.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualified Lead – Finance & Accounts to take complete ownership of the finance and accounting function at Youthville.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a finance professional who has worked in a startup or high-growth business environment and can independently manage end-to-end finance operations, financial planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, cash flow, audits and management reporting.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical accounting expertise with business acumen, leadership capabilities and the ability to build scalable financial systems in a growing organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Finance & Accounting**

Take complete ownership of the finance and accounts function across the organisation.

Oversee day-to-day accounting, general ledger, journal entries, reconciliations and month-end and year-end closures.

Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, including the Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement.

Establish robust accounting policies, internal controls and standard operating procedures.

Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, vendor payments, customer collections, advances and accruals.

Monitor financial transactions across properties, departments and business entities.

**2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Analysis**

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.

Prepare monthly MIS reports, variance analysis and financial dashboards for management.

Analyse revenue, operating costs, property-level profitability and business performance.

Monitor key financial indicators, cost efficiency and profitability across locations.

Provide actionable financial insights to management for strategic and operational decisions.

Support business expansion plans through financial modelling, feasibility analysis and investment evaluation.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

Manage direct and indirect taxation, including income tax, GST, TDS and applicable statutory compliances.

Ensure timely filing of returns, payment of taxes and reconciliation of statutory records.

Oversee tax audits, statutory audits, internal audits and other regulatory requirements.

Coordinate with external consultants, auditors, banks and regulatory authorities.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws and corporate regulations.

Monitor compliance requirements across relevant legal entities and business operations.

**4. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

Manage daily cash flow, liquidity planning and working capital requirements.

Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate funds for business operations.

Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor settlements and collection cycles.

Develop controls for payment approvals, expense management and fund utilisation.

Maintain banking relationships and support financing requirements wherever applicable.

**5. Internal Controls & Process Automation**

Develop and implement strong financial controls and approval mechanisms.

Identify opportunities to automate accounting, reporting and finance workflows.

Improve financial processes, documentation, reconciliation and audit readiness.

Implement standardised finance practices across properties and business units.

Work with cross-functional teams to ensure financial discipline and process compliance.

**6. Leadership & Business Partnering**

Lead, mentor and develop the finance and accounts team.

Establish clear responsibilities, performance standards and reporting timelines.

Partner with business leaders, operations, sales, procurement and management teams.

Work closely with senior management on financial strategy, risk management and business planning.

Support new property launches, expansion projects, commercial evaluations and financial due diligence.

Build a proactive finance function that supports business growth rather than merely recording transactions.

**Candidate Requirements**

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) qualified — mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated leadership or team-management experience.

Startup exposure: Prior experience working in a startup, scale-up or high-growth organisation is strongly preferred.

Strong expertise in end-to-end accounting, taxation, financial reporting, budgeting, MIS and cash flow management.

Experience managing audits, statutory compliances and multiple business operations or entities.

Ability to independently lead the finance function and establish processes from the ground up.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Proficiency in accounting systems, Excel and financial reporting tools; experience with ERP or cloud-based accounting platforms is an advantage.

A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

**Why Join Youthville?**

Be Part of a Growing Business

Join an expanding managed-accommodation venture and contribute to building the financial backbone of a growing hospitality business.

End-to-End Ownership

Lead the complete finance and accounting function, with the opportunity to shape processes, controls, reporting systems and financial strategy.

Direct Management Exposure

Work closely with senior leadership and contribute to key business decisions, expansion planning and operational improvements.

Build and Improve Systems

Create scalable financial processes and introduce automation, stronger controls and data-driven decision-making.

Entrepreneurial Work Environment

Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where initiative, accountability and practical problem-solving matter.

Compensation & Employment Details

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a finance leader who has moved beyond routine accounting and is ready to take complete ownership of a growing organisation's financial operations. Someone who understands startup realities, builds processes without excessive supervision, maintains financial discipline and translates financial data into meaningful business decisions.

If you are a qualified CA with startup experience and a passion for building scalable finance functions, we would love to hear from you.

This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. title: Senior Energy Market Analyst (Solutions)
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Position**

As a member of the APAC Solutions team, the
**Senior Energy Market Analyst**
will be responsible for engaging directly with both potential and existing clients to increase sales and deliver technical work. The successful candidate will help drive Energy Exemplar’s growth in markets across the APAC region, by working with the sales team to identifying relevant customer use cases and assist in the development of the go to market strategy. The Senior Energy Market Analyst
will act as an energy markets subject matter expert, responsible for thought leadership towards customers. They will seek to understand the customers challenges, identify solutions within the Energy Exemplar product offerings, and articulate the value proposition within the marketplace. The role has a heavy modelling focus.

The successful candidate will be expected to heavily contribute to the building of energy market models for those regions, using Energy Exemplar’s flagship PLEXOS software tool (the role does not require programming/software development). The candidate should have a good understanding of fundamental market price drivers, and ideally have experience in stochastic optimization techniques.

This Senior Energy Market Analyst works in close collaboration with a team of technical subject matter experts. The position is supported by strong training, coaching, and mentoring and provides opportunity for professional growth and career advancement, as well as international travel to customer sites. Successful candidates will have a strong background in modelling, and good customer facing skills; as well as being outgoing, professional, driven, and able to multi-task in a dynamic and often changing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical discussions and provide strategic modeling insights to clients.
* Develop and validate complex optimization models tailored to customer needs.
* Guide junior analysts and provide mentorship in modeling best practices.
* Conduct in-depth research on policy impacts, market developments, and emerging technologies.
* Manage project lifecycles, from scoping to delivery, ensuring customer success.
* Collaborate with the product development team to enhance software capabilities.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Deep knowledge of energy markets & associated economics
* Expertise in model setup, custom configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in scripting, automation, and integrating market datasets.
* Ability to communicate complex subject matter in an easy to understand manner
* Strong commercial awareness
* Top down approach to problem solving – ability to see the big picture
* Strong interpersonal presence and skills - demonstrated ability to build rapport
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Strong listening and presentation skills
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Self-driven, results-orientated with a positive outlook and a focus on quality
* Thorough knowledge of standard Microsoft programs – Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Strong desire for personal and career advancement

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field.
* 5+ years of experience in energy market modeling, forecasting, or optimization.
* Extensive experience in PLEXOS or similar optimization software.
* Strong leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

title: IRRBB Modelling Lead in Group Treasury
description:
**Job Type**
Full Time
  
  
**Job Reference #**
344171BR
  
  
**City**
Pune
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are expanding our Group Treasury Modelling capabilities to strengthen behavioral modelling of residential mortgages and non-maturing deposits (NMDs) for interest rate risk management. In this role, you will develop models that capture complex client behaviors through scenario-based cash flow projections and convert them into advanced interest rate risk metrics and replicating portfolios. These models will directly inform our
  
  
Economic Value (EV) and Net Interest Income (NII) risk management, support Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and
  
  
profitability analysis, and guide hedging strategies across the balance sheet.
  
  
What you’ll do:
  
  

* residential mortgage modelling: Integrate, maintain and calibrate our prepayment models based on ADCO loan dynamics suite. Develop, integrate and enhance our OAS modelling framework combining term structure modelling with the prepayment models to ensure convexity and path dependent outcomes are captured for optimal hedging strategies. Develop a mortgage pipe-line pull-through model;
* advance risk metrics and hedging strategies for convexity risk management;
* commercial Real Estate (CRE) modelling: develop and maintain US CRE mortgage prepayment model and integrate into the OAS valuation engine and NII interest rate risk platforms;
* NMD replication modelling: develop and maintain non-maturing deposit replication models. Build and calibrate replicating portfolio (RPF) strategies that convert depositor behavior into fixed cash-flow ladders to capture behavioral duration profiles. Develop and advance deposit rate modelling (DRM) and volume/attrition modelling, and incorporate their outputs to replication strategies and NII projections;
* EVS/NII and FTP integration: support alignment of model methodologies with margin-stripped EVS policies. Integrate model outputs into our EVS/NII risk management and FTP frameworks;
* tooling and productionization: build robust, well-tested Python/C++ libraries and prototypes. Partner with technology teams to deploy these models into production risk engines and P&L tools used by ALM Strategy and Structural Rates Trading;
* model governance: document model assumptions, methodologies, and controls in line with UBS model risk standards. Regularly recalibrate and test models, and support material model changes through established governance processes;
* cross-functional collaboration: work closely with colleagues in Trading, Risk, Finance, Model Validation, and Technology. Present analysis in governance forums and respond to regulatory or audit queries with clarity and rigor.

**The team**
You will join our Group Treasury Modelling team based in Pune and work closely with our U.S. team based in New York. Our mandate is to model interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB) for Wealth Management products and develop ALM strategies for hedging and optimizing interest income. The team is responsible for modeling non-maturing loans and deposits and mortgages, as well as maintaining and documenting these models. Our U.S. team works closely with counterparts in Switzerland to meet both regional and global requirements.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience**

* Education: advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, financial engineering, computer science, econometrics, or a related quantitative field.
* Required experience: minimum 5 years in a Treasury or Asset-Liability Management function. Strong knowledge of interest rate and term structure risk modelling, financial markets, and derivatives. Hands on experience with mortgage modelling required, including optionality and prepayment features.
* Preferred experience with deposit rate modelling (DRM), attrition modelling, and replication modelling. Familiarity with EVS/NII, FTP, and margin-stripping practices. Exposure to OCC, FDIC, or BCBS IRRBB regulatory guidelines.
* Quantitative skills: proven ability to apply numerical analysis, statistics, and financial mathematics to design, validate, and maintain risk management models.
* Technical skills: proficiency in Python, C++, SQL, and MS Office. Experience with time-series analysis, survival/ hazard modelling, regime-switching or state-space models, Monte Carlo simulation, optimization, and back testing. Strong documentation skills.
* Collaboration: ability to work effectively with colleagues in Trading, Risk, Technology, Finance, and Model Validation. Team player with a can-do attitude, comfortable working in an international team environment.
* Mindset: comfortable with change. Proactive, structured, and committed to high-quality model development and governance.

**About Us**
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
  
  
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Internal Auditor is an opportunity for a curious, detail-oriented professional who wants to build a strong foundation in internal audit, controls, risk management, and business process improvement within a global manufacturing organization. This role supports global financial and Sarbanes-Oxley audit activities while gaining exposure to business leaders, corporate functions, and operations across the company.
  
  
In this role, you will perform audit procedures, evaluate internal controls, analyze data, document results, and help translate findings into practical recommendations that strengthen Avient’s control environment and support continuous improvement. You will also have opportunities to contribute to operational and risk-based audits, advisory projects, due diligence activities, and data analytics initiatives that provide meaningful insights to the business.
  
  
This position is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, learning how businesses operate, working collaboratively across functions, and developing technical audit skills in a supportive, growth-oriented environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Support and, as experience develops, lead internal audit projects as part of Avient’s annual risk-based internal audit plan, including planning, scoping, execution, documentation, and reporting.
* Perform internal control assessments of Avient’s global financial processes, including identifying key controls, evaluating control design, testing operating effectiveness, and documenting results in accordance with audit standards.
* Execute Sarbanes-Oxley audit procedures and support management’s assessment of internal controls over financial reporting.
* Analyze financial, operational, and process data to identify trends, risks, control gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare clear, well-organized audit workpapers, summaries, and reports that support audit conclusions and communicate results effectively.
* Partner with business process owners and corporate functions to understand processes, gather information, validate findings, and support practical remediation plans.
* Track and follow up on management action plans to ensure audit findings and recommendations are addressed timely and effectively.
* Present audit observations, insights, and practical recommendations to internal audit leadership, business partners, and senior management.
* Support ad-hoc audits, advisory projects, data analytics initiatives, and other special projects that provide quantitative and qualitative insight to Avient’s businesses or corporate functions.
* Provide support for due diligence activities related to potential acquisitions, including review of financial, operational, and control-related information.
* Stay current on internal audit practices, internal control concepts, data analytics tools, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

**Scope**
This position conducts audit activities that are global in scope.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Data Science, or a related business field is required.
* 4+ years of accounting, finance, audit, internal controls, data analytics, or related experience preferred; relevant internship, co-op, or project experience will be considered.
* Experience with internal audit, Sarbanes-Oxley compliance, financial controls, public accounting, or manufacturing environments preferred.
* Exposure to global business processes, financial reporting, business process controls, or enterprise systems preferred.
* One or more professional certifications or progress toward certification preferred, including CPA, CIA, CFE, or CMA.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Strong interest in internal audit, risk management, financial controls, business process improvement, and data-driven problem-solving.
* Foundational understanding of financial business processes, accounting principles, internal controls, and control documentation.
* Ability to think critically, ask thoughtful questions, evaluate information objectively, and connect details to broader business risks and opportunities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with financial, operational, and process data; experience with data analytics tools preferred.
* Experience with SAP or other enterprise resource planning systems preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize complex information clearly and concisely for a variety of audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Collaborative, customer-focused approach with the ability to build effective working relationships across functions, geographies, and levels of the organization.
* High degree of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and accountability.
* Self-motivated learner who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment that values empowerment, continuous improvement, and professional development.

**About Us**
Our purpose at Avient Corporation is to be an innovator of materials solutions that help our customers succeed, while enabling a sustainable world.
  
  
Innovation goes far beyond materials science; it’s powered by the passion, creativity, and diverse expertise of 9,000 professionals worldwide. Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.
  
  
Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!
  
  
We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.
  
  
By
*playing to win, acting customer centric, driving innovation and profitable growth, collaborating seamlessly across Avient, and motivating and inspiring and developing others and yourself*
you will accelerate your ability to achieve Avient’s strategic goals, to meet our customer needs, and to accomplish your career goals.
  
  
At Avient, we believe a wide variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds gives us the creativity to be successful in a rapidly changing world. In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.

title: Service Delivery Leader - Technical Accounting (Record to Report - R2R)
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**

The Technical Accounting Service Delivery Leader (SDL) owns end-to-end R2R operational delivery, technical accounting governance, financial controls, and service performance across Banking, Consolidation & Reporting, Fixed Assets, Internal Development Software (IDSW), Lease Accounting and Intercompany towers in R2R Team.

The SDL is accountable for service delivery performance (CSL/SLA), close governance, technical accounting execution, audit readiness, stakeholder management, organizational leadership, transformation delivery and risk management across the Technical Accounting organization.

This role serves as the primary bridge between Global Finance Operations and Corporate Controllership, ensuring that operational execution remains aligned with accounting policies, financial reporting requirements, SOX/ICFR expectations and enterprise governance standards.

The SDL leads a multi-layer organization consisting of R2R Directors, R2R Associate Directors, R2R Senior Managers and specialized accounting teams, providing strategic direction, technical leadership and operational oversight to ensure predictable, high-quality and audit-ready outcomes.

This role requires strong technical accounting expertise across Consolidation, Banking, Fixed Assets, IDSW, Lease Accounting and Intercompany processes, coupled with demonstrated success in leading large-scale global finance operations.

**Focus & Scope**

**Focus:**

Enterprise technical accounting governance, service delivery excellence, close management, financial controls, stakeholder leadership and transformation execution.

**Scope:**

* Oversees day-to-day performance across Banking, Consolidation & Reporting, Fixed Assets, IDSW, Lease Accounting and Intercompany towers in R2R Team
* Ensures financial statement integrity through disciplined close execution, technical accounting compliance and strong control environments
* Owns close readiness, service delivery performance, operational risk management and governance across all technical accounting towers
* Maintains a robust operating rhythm including executive governance forums, close cockpit reviews, risk management, audit readiness and post-close lessons learned
* Ensures all outputs meet NIQ standards for SOX/ICFR compliance, IPE integrity, OneStream certification, accounting policy compliance and audit readiness
* Leads a global organization of 100+ finance professionals through multiple management layers including Directors, Associate Directors and Senior Managers
* Serves as primary escalation point for significant accounting, reporting, operational and stakeholder matters

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Accounting Governance & Leadership**

* Provide technical accounting leadership across Banking, Consolidation, Fixed Assets, IDSW, Lease Accounting and Intercompany towers
* Partner with Corporate Accounting and Accounting Policy teams on implementation of new accounting standards, accounting policy changes and technical accounting guidance
* Lead resolution of complex accounting issues, accounting judgments and non-routine transactions
* Ensure consistent application of accounting policies across all entities and regions

**Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary interface between Global Finance Operations and Corporate Controllers, Regional Controllers, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, Corporate Accounting, External Reporting and Audit leadership
* Lead executive governance forums and service reviews
* Influence enterprise decisions through technical accounting expertise and operational insights

**Close Governance & Execution Control**

* Lead monthly, quarterly and year-end close governance through structured execution, dependency management and close readiness reviews
* Confirm readiness across all technical accounting towers before critical close milestones
* Ensure timely completion of reporting, certification and close activities

**Service Performance (CSL/SLA) Ownership**

* Own CSL/SLA delivery across all technical accounting towers
* Monitor performance trends, identify root causes and drive sustainable improvements
* Ensure consistent performance measurement through standardized reporting

**SOX / IPE Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Ensure controls are executed consistently across all towers
* Enforce audit-ready execution, evidence retention and certification standards
* Drive remediation where control performance or evidence quality is insufficient

**Risk, Controls & Governance**

* Maintain enterprise risk and issue management framework across all technical accounting towers
* Drive proactive identification and mitigation of financial reporting, operational and compliance risks
* Lead remediation of audit findings, control deficiencies and recurring operational issues

* People Leadership & Talent Development
* Lead and develop Directors, Associate Directors and Senior Managers
* Drive succession planning, leadership development and organizational capability building
* Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, transparency and continuous improvement

**Transformation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation, standardization and process simplification initiatives
* Partner with GPO, Enablement and FinTech teams to implement transformation roadmaps
* Sponsor AI, automation and digital finance initiatives

**Financial Stewardship**

* Manage resource plans, productivity targets and operational efficiency initiatives
* Support cost-to-serve optimization and workforce planning across the organization

**Qualifications**

* **15–20 years of experience**
  in R2R/RTR, Technical Accounting, Controllership, or Financial Reporting, including leadership of large global teams
* **CA, CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification**
  preferred
* Strong expertise in
  **Consolidation & Reporting, Banking, Fixed Assets, Lease Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, and Technical Accounting**
* Deep knowledge of
  **US GAAP, IFRS, SOX/ICFR, audit readiness, and financial controls**
* Proven experience leading
  **global close governance, close orchestration, and service delivery (CSL/SLA) performance**
* Demonstrated success managing
  **multi-layer organizations**
  and partnering with senior stakeholders across Controllers, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, and Audit
* Hands-on experience with
  **SAP, OneStream, Nakisa, ServiceNow, Coupa TM5, Power BI, and finance automation tools**
* Strong track record of driving
  **automation, AI-enabled transformation, process standardization, and operational excellence**
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, risk management, and problem-solving skills

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
