title: Manager, Accounting
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Accounting
  
  
**About Mastercard**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven Manager, Accounting to lead and manage the accounting operations within our Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of accounting activities, supporting both corporate and statutory reporting requirements.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting operations, a proven ability to manage teams, and experience working in a fast-paced, global environment. This position requires a hands-on approach to managing processes, resolving issues timely, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and invest in to ensure operational excellence with a highly customer centric approach.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**
Accounting Operations Management:
  
  

* Oversee the day-to-day accounting operations, including cash reconciliation, general ledger management, month-end and year-end close processes, reconciling cash and cash equivalent accounts, effective monitoring of control accounts and variance analysis of periodic movements around our diverse global cash operations.
* Ensure compliance with US GAAP and corporate policies.
* Manage the preparation and review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and subledger-to-general ledger reconciliations.

Collaborate closely with Treasury and cross-functional teams to drive the accurate and efficient management of cash operations
  
  
**Financial Reporting & Compliance**

* Support audit requirements.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial and operational reports, balance sheet disclosures/footnotes, meeting internal and external deadlines.
* Maintain a robust internal control framework to mitigate risks and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Able to lead, mentor and motivate a team of accounting professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.
* Able to provide coaching and development opportunities to enhance team members' technical and leadership skills.
* Allocate tasks effectively, ensuring team efficiency and alignment with organizational priorities.

**Process Improvement & Optimization**

* Identify and implement process improvements to streamline workflows, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency in accounting operations.
* Leverage technology and automation tools, to optimize accounting processes.
* Drive standardization of accounting practices across multiple entities and regions.
* Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with cross-functional teams, including Treasury, Corporate Controllership, to support business needs and strategic initiatives.
* Communicate effectively with senior management, providing insights into accounting operations and key financial metrics.
* Address escalations from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring timely resolution of issues.

**All About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CA, or equivalent certification preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years in a SME/lead role.
* Strong understanding of subledger and controlling accounts for AP, AR, Intercompany etc
* Strong technical expertise in accounting operations, including GL management, reconciliations, and close processes.
* In-depth knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, and statutory reporting requirements.
* Proficiency in Oracle systems is must
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong commitment to customer service excellence, featuring a customer-centric mindset
* Thorough understanding of MS Excel (Knowledge in PowerBI/Power Automate is beneficial)
* Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: FS RC-FSRM - CSTC-FINANCIAL ANALYSIS-MANAGER
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Business Solutions – Manager**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

 Within FSRM, the Business Solutions team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, CECL, BASEL, credit risk and ICAAP related activities:
   

  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ capital projections, Individual Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP), capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), as well as owning the ICAAP framework and standards, and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/CECL/COREP/FINREP regulations or Pillar 2 / ICAAP framework
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators (especially with the PRA and ECB).


 Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel; analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 7\-10 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Manager- P&L
description:
**Role: Business Manager \- P\&L** 




**Location: Pune (On\-Site)** 




  





**About the role** 




 Own the P\&L for our international patient business at CureMeAbroad. You'll know the revenue, margin, and unit economics of every specialty, hospital, and source market, and act on those numbers through pricing, package design, and cost control. You'll work directly with the founding team. This is a business\-owner role, not a process\-management role.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own the P\&L for patient services: revenue, gross and contribution margin, budgeting, and forecasting.
* Track unit economics by specialty, hospital, and source market, and turn them into decisions on pricing, packages, and cost control.
* Work with the partnerships team on hospital commercial terms: rate cards, volume commitments, and quality\-linked pricing.
* Work with finance on budgets, cost estimates, and monthly reporting.
* Drive patient operations and customer success outcomes (turnaround times, retention, referrals, patient satisfaction) through the ops and CS team, and stay accountable for how they affect margin.
* Flag and escalate critical and high\-risk cases to the founders.
* Build dashboards and a regular business review that show where we make and lose money.



  





**What you'll bring (must\-have)** 



* 4\-6 years of total experience, with 2\+ years owning or closely managing a P\&L, business unit, or budget.
* 3\+ years of full\-time experience in a startup or scale\-up. This is mandatory: you're comfortable with ambiguity, thin processes, and wearing multiple hats.
* Strong command of unit economics, margins, and forecasting, and comfort building models in Excel or Sheets.
* Ability to negotiate and structure commercial terms with external partners.
* Clear communication, and comfort working with clinical, ops, finance, and partnership stakeholders across time zones.



  





**Good to have** 




 Background in strategy, consulting, business\-unit management, or finance business partnering.
 



 Experience in healthcare, medical travel, hospitality, or another high\-touch service business.

description:
Centre for Research in Wellbeing and Happiness, FLAME University, Pune, invites applications for the position of “Research Analyst” on a contractual basis for a period of one year, subject to further extension.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  




* Position Research Analyst
* Duration 1 Year \- (1st November 2026 to 31st October 2027\)
* Gross Remuneration: INR 35,000 per month
* Last Date to Apply: 15th October 2026
* List of Shortlisted Candidates 20th October 2026
* Interview: 26th October 2026
* Date of Joining: 1st November 2026



  





**Description:** 
 The Research Analyst will support ongoing and new research projects of the Centre, particularly in the areas of public health, health economics, health systems and policy, population studies, and socioeconomic inequalities in health and well\-being. The role will involve working across different stages of the research process, including literature reviews, primary and secondary data collection, data analysis, interpretation and presentation of findings, and preparation of research reports, policy briefs, manuscripts, and other research outputs. The candidate will be expected to work with large\-scale survey and administrative datasets and assist in applying appropriate statistical and econometric methods. The role may also involve supporting field\-based research, surveys, and data collection, depending on project requirements. Candidates should have strong analytical and writing skills, an interest in applied and policy\-relevant research, and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with researchers and faculty members.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Support ongoing and new research projects of the Centre, particularly in the areas of public health, health economics, health systems and policy, population studies, and socioeconomic inequalities in health and well\-being.
* Work across different stages of the research process, including literature reviews, primary and secondary data collection, data analysis, interpretation and presentation of findings.
* Prepare research reports, policy briefs, manuscripts, and other research outputs.
* Work with large\-scale survey and administrative datasets and assist in applying appropriate statistical and econometric methods.
* Support field\-based research, surveys, and data collection, depending on project requirements.
* Work independently as well as collaboratively with researchers and faculty members.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Essential Qualification: A minimum of an undergraduate degree in Economics, Public Health, Public Policy, Statistics, Demography/Population Studies, or a related discipline.
* Desirable Qualification: A postgraduate degree or higher qualification in any of the above\-mentioned disciplines. Compensation may be negotiable for candidates who have completed a Master’s degree, commensurate with their qualifications and experience.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong analytical and writing skills.
* An interest in applied and policy\-relevant research.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with researchers and faculty members.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience working with large\-scale survey and administrative datasets.
* Familiarity with appropriate statistical and econometric methods.
* Experience in field\-based research, surveys, and data collection.



  





  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  




* Gross Remuneration INR 35000 per month.
* Compensation may be negotiable for candidates who have completed a Master’s degree, commensurate with their qualifications and experience.



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Interested candidates may send their application to crwbh@flame.edu.in along with their full CV and a brief note (200 words) outlining their research interests and goals.
 



  





**General Instructions** 




  




* Candidates should possess the prescribed qualification and experience as of the closing date of application. Candidates are required to produce specific certificates as per eligibility conditions whenever asked.
* Further, merely fulfilling the minimum qualifications or the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be necessarily considered or called for a written test/evaluation. More stringent criteria may be applied for short\-listing the candidates to be called for an evaluation.
* Applications which do not meet the criteria given in this advertisement and/or incomplete applications are liable to be summarily rejected.

The Director, CRWBH, FLAME University is competent to decide not to fill the above posts without assigning any reason. The Institute can also consider suitable candidates who may not have applied. The decision of the Selection Committee shall be final.

The Specialist serves as a key point of contact for stakeholders across Procurement, Accounts Payable, and field operations, supporting end\-to\-end operational integrity and data governance.

* Maintain accurate employee and cost center data in Concur, including manager updates and employee terminations for corporate card accounts.
* Extend suppliers to additional company codes and manage DRF replication to Ariba.
* Resend onboarding requests, unlink supplier users in Ariba, and support government entity or tax/utility vendor setup.
* Review unassigned individual accounts in Concur and address authorization or decline issues with corporate card transactions.
* Process checks requests, supplier credit requests, and manage compliance activities such as reviewing expiring Certificates of Insurance.
* Facilitate operational support tasks such as inventory counts and Home Depot user access. Support P2P policy compliance, data quality, and operational inquiries from internal stakeholders and suppliers.


****EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS:****
**Education and Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2–4 years of experience in Procurement, Accounts Payable, P2P operations, or supplier master data administration.
* Experience working with SAP (vendor master), Ariba (supplier enablement), and Concur (T\&E processing) preferred.

title: Finance Enterprise Systems Director (Netsuite)
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an AI\-forward, strategic Senior Manager to lead our Finance Applications portfolio within Enterprise Systems. This is a high\-impact role for a leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings order to complex cross\-functional programs, and uses AI as a force multiplier across delivery, design, and decision\-making. You will own end\-to\-end transformation of our Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, and Record\-to\-Report ecosystems — partnering with Finance, Procurement, Revenue Operations, IT, and external vendors to deliver outcomes that move the business forward.
   

  

 If you are equally comfortable architecting a multi\-quarter roadmap, stakeholder management, performing RCA, and presenting risk trade\-offs to executives — we want to talk to you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead with strategy. Define and own the multi\-year roadmap for Finance enterprise applications, aligning technology investments with business objectives across Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, and Revenue/Close cycles.
* Turn chaos into clarity. Step into ambiguous, fast\-moving programs and bring structure — clear scope, owners, decisions, and outcomes — without slowing the business down.
* Drive AI\-native delivery. Embed AI tools (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and emerging assistants) into how the team operates: requirements drafting, test case generation, change documentation, status reporting, code review, and stakeholder communication. Set the standard for what an AI\-augmented Finance Systems team looks like.
* Own the systems stack. Provide hands\-on leadership across NetSuite, Zuora, SAP Ariba, and Klarity — partnering with admins, developers, and integration teams on configuration, enhancements, integrations, and support.
* Manage stakeholders end\-to\-end. Be the trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, RevOps, Procurement, Legal, and IT leadership. Translate business problems into delivery plans; translate technical trade\-offs into business language.
* Run disciplined programs. Establish PMO best practices, govern scope/schedule/budget/quality, lead steering committees, manage risks and escalations, and deliver predictably across waterfall, Agile (Scrum/Kanban), and hybrid models.
* Lead vendors and SIs. Manage external implementation partners and product vendors — set expectations, hold them to outcomes, and integrate their work cleanly with internal teams.
* Protect the business. Ensure compliance with SOX, ITGC, and information security policies. Partner with internal and external auditors as a credible system and process owner.
* Continuously improve. Identify automation, simplification, and AI\-driven opportunities that reduce cost, accelerate close, improve data quality, and free the team for higher\-leverage work.


**Qualifications**
* Experience. 15\+ years in Enterprise Systems / Technical Program Management, including 5\+ years leading Finance application portfolios in mid\-to\-large enterprises (preferably SaaS, subscription, or high\-growth tech).
* Hands\-on systems expertise. Deep, working knowledge of NetSuite (ERP), Zuora (Revenue) and SAP Ariba (Procure\-to\-Pay). You can sit with an admin or developer and reason about configuration, data flow, and integration design — not just manage from a distance.
* AI fluency — hands\-on, not theoretical. Demonstrated, daily use of Claude and/or Microsoft Copilot to ship work faster: writing prompts that get usable output, building lightweight workflows, evaluating AI suggestions critically, and coaching a team/s to do the same.
* Stakeholder management at the highest level. Track record of influencing VPs, CFOs, controller, and cross\-functional peers — managing divergent expectations and landing decisions in writing.
* Chaos\-to\-clarity operator. Known for walking into messy programs and producing a one\-page plan that everyone agrees with by end of week.
* Program delivery range. Comfort with both Waterfall and Agile (Scrum, Kanban, Lean); fluent in Jira, Confluence, MS Project, and modern collaboration tooling.
* Compliance grounding. Practical understanding of SOX, ITGC, segregation of duties, and audit support for finance systems.
* Education. Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related discipline. MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.


**Nice To have :**
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience with Salesforce, Coupa, or Oracle Fusion Apps adjacent to the core stack.
* Prior experience leading offshore/onshore delivery models from Pune.
* Exposure to data platforms azure datalake and finance analytics.

title: EYP-IA-Assistant Manager
description:

Our team helps clients create long\-term social and economic value by enabling informed decision\-making around capital investments, transactions, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 In this role, you will support clients in developing, reviewing, and enhancing complex financial models for infrastructure projects, transaction support, and corporate strategy engagements. Leveraging both traditional modelling techniques and advanced technologies such as Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Agentic AI and Python, you will help deliver data\-driven insights that address client needs and support critical business decisions.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a leading global organization and accelerate your career through diverse engagements, continuous learning, and mentorship opportunities. As a member of the Modelling and Analytics team, you will apply sophisticated financial and data analytics techniques to solve complex business challenges, improve decision\-making, and help clients make faster, more informed choices in a rapidly evolving
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and support engagement teams in delivering Financial Modelling, Analytics, and Strategic Advisory services, enabling clients to make informed decisions related to investments, transactions, financing, operations, and long\-term growth strategies.

* Support the development and assessment of Public\-Private Partnership (PPP) arrangements, project structuring, commercial evaluations, and procurement strategies.

* Apply advanced data analytics, automation, and visualization tools, including Power BI, Power Query, Python, VBA, and Excel, to transform complex data into actionable insights and decision\-support frameworks.
* Perform independent reviews and validation of financial models, identify key risks and assumptions, conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses, and present findings to clients in a clear and concise manner.
* Drive research and development initiatives, including market intelligence, industry benchmarking, policy and regulatory analysis, emerging technology assessments, and the development of innovative analytical tools, methodologies, and best practices.
* Contribute to thought leadership and knowledge development through research publications, sector insights, white papers, and the creation of reusable frameworks that enhance EY's Infrastructure Advisory capabilities globally.
* Collaborate with EY's global Infrastructure Advisory teams to deliver high\-quality services across project finance, infrastructure transactions, corporate finance, sustainability, and strategic advisory assignments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong academic background preferably with a professional qualification in finance/ MBA/ accounting/ CFA/ FRM and solid understanding of corporate finance
* Experience in one or more infrastructure sectors \- power \& utilities, Oil and Gas including renewables, transport, and social infrastructure, etc.
* Strong quantitative skills with the ability to understand financial statements and build three statement financial models in Excel. Exposure to VBA will be preferred.
* Experience with building dynamic dashboards or automated corporate strategy solutions using Databricks, Python, or Agentic AI
* Knowledge of PPP/ PFI modelling is preferred
* Exceptional economic and financial modelling skills with a demonstrated aptitude in quantitative and qualitative study
* Knowledge of Alteryx and Visualization tools (preferred)
* Exceptional analytical, problem solving and presentation/ report writing skills, combined with a good understanding of business dynamics and commercial value drivers
* Exhibit thoughtfulness and problem\-solving skills
* Good project and time management skills with the ability to multi\-task
* Ability to coach and mentor team members on writing, technical skills and soft skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Postgraduate in the areas of environment, sustainability, energy or related field Management/ MBA/ CFA/ FRM from a reputed college/ University. Professional qualification in Finance / Power / Infrastructure Management will be preferred.
* Relevant experience of 7\-8 years for Associate Manager and 6\-7 years for Assistant Manager


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
 Experience of working in professional services industry which will give an edge
   

  

**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-prominent, multi\-disciplinary team of 1500 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts
* On\-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business\-as\-usual execution

**Experience**

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
The Procurement Coordinator supports global procurement operations by maintaining procurement systems, coordinating supplier documentation, and enabling efficient Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes. This role partners with sourcing, supplier quality, finance, and cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate procurement data, resolve supplier payment issues, support sourcing activities, and drive continuous process improvements. The Procurement Coordinator leverages analytical skills, procurement systems, and reporting tools to enhance operational efficiency while supporting cost, quality, delivery, and compliance objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Maintain supplier information and procurement master data to ensure accuracy and integrity across procurement systems.
* Proactively engage with suppliers to obtain required documentation, maintain supplier records, and support supplier enablement activities.
* Coordinate and resolve supplier invoice, payment, and procurement transaction issues by partnering with suppliers, sourcing, finance, and internal stakeholders.
* Support Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, including invoice price variance (IPV), purchase order price variance (PPV), and other procurement\-related discrepancies.
* Prepare and manage procurement documentation for sourcing events, supplier contracts, and purchasing activities while ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
* Support supplier quality initiatives by collaborating with Supplier Quality Engineers, category teams, and suppliers to improve supplier performance.
* Act as a liaison between procurement and cross\-functional teams to facilitate effective communication and issue resolution.
* Generate reports, dashboards, and procurement analytics using business systems and reporting tools to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ensure procurement data integrity by monitoring, validating, and continuously improving procurement information and reporting processes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline procurement workflows, improve business processes, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Support project implementation activities by coordinating supplier deliverables, monitoring timelines, and ensuring successful execution of procurement\-related initiatives.
* Participate in health, safety, environmental, and compliance initiatives while adhering to Cummins policies and ethical procurement standards.
* Perform additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned to support business objectives.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong understanding of Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes.
* Knowledge of procurement systems, purchasing, supplier management, and payment processes.
* Ability to identify and resolve procurement issues by distinguishing process, system, and data\-related root causes.
* Experience reviewing procurement cost variances, including Invoice Price Variance (IPV) and Purchase Order Price Variance (PPV).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret transactional data and recommend corrective actions.
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Advanced Excel (including Macros), SQL, or similar tools.
* Understanding of procurement policies, procedures, compliance, and ethical sourcing practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex issues for diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within global teams.


**Preferred Experience**
* Relevant experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Purchasing Operations, Finance Operations, or Shared Services.
* Experience working with ERP and procurement platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, Coupa, or equivalent procurement systems.
* Exposure to supplier onboarding, supplier payment management, procurement master data, and supplier documentation processes.

description:
**About Calfus**

We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era. Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start\-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth.  As one of the fastest\-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed—without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high\-energy, driven individuals.
 



 To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 The Senior AP Deployment Specialist serves as a dedicated Accounts Payable Operations representative assigned full\-time to the global invoice intake and processing transformation program. Acting as the AP Operations throughout the deployment lifecycle, the role supports discovery, process reviews, business requirement validation, testing, deployment readiness, go\-live, hyper\-care, and stabilization activities. The position operates separately from day\-to\-day Accounts Payable processing teams, allowing business\-as\-usual operations to remain focused on service delivery while dedicated AP deployment specialists support the transformation program full\-time. Working closely with country AP teams, the AP Process Transformation \& AI Deployment Specialist, Change Management \& Training Lead, project teams, and technology partners, the Senior AP Deployment Specialist helps ensure future\-state solutions are practical, sustainable, compliant, and aligned with real\-world AP operating requirements.
 



  





**AP Business Ownership** 




 • Throughout discovery, design validation, testing, deployment, hyper\-care, and stabilization the AP operations activities
 



 • Ensure documented requirements and configured solutions accurately reflect AP operational needs, controls, exception handling practices, and business requirements.
 



 • Act as the primary working\-level representative between AP Operations and the deployment program.
 



 • Champion AP user readiness, operational adoption, and long\-term sustainability of future\-state processes.
 



  





**Function:** 
 Global Accounts Payable
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India (Pls apply only if you are willing to relocate)
 



**Focus:** 
 Country Rollout \& AP Deployment
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 




  




1. **Discovery \& Country Requirements**



 • Participate in country discovery workshops, process walkthroughs, and design discussions.
 



 • Demonstrate and explain current\-state AP processes, controls, approval of workflows, exception handling, and operational practices.
 



 • Identify country\-specific legal, tax, regulatory, compliance, language, and operational requirements.
 



 • Validate that local requirements are correctly understood and documented.
 



 • Assess operational impacts associated with proposed future\-state processes.
 



  





**2\. Process Validation \& Future\-State Readiness** 




 • Review and validate Process Design Documents (PDDs), business requirements, process flows, controls, exception scenarios, and operating procedures.
 



 • Confirm that future\-state processes accurately reflect AP operational requirements and business realities.
 



 • Evaluate how future\-state processes will be operated, supported, and governed by AP after deployment.
 



 • Identify operational gaps, support requirements, ownership requirements, and adoption risks. • Validate that future\-state solutions are scalable, sustainable, and practical for long\-term AP operations.
 



  





**3\. Business Validation \& User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** 




 • Develop end\-to\-end UAT scenarios and business test scripts based on real AP operational activities, controls, and exception handling requirements.
 



 • Prepare and maintain required business test data.
 



 • Execute UAT and validate solutions against approved business requirements.
 



 • Confirm that business outcomes are achieved, not solely that system functions operate.
 



 • Identify defects, process gaps, usability concerns, operational impacts, and business risks.
 



 • Support defect triage, retesting, and business sign\-off activities. SIT ownership: System Integration Testing is performed by the implementation and development teams. The Senior AP Deployment Specialist focuses on business validation and UAT activities.
 



  





**4\. Deployment Readiness \& Go\-Live Support** 




 • Support deployment planning, readiness assessments, cutover activities, and country go\-live preparations.
 



 • Confirm operational readiness across users, controls, work instructions, exception handling procedures, and support processes.
 



 • Coordinate deployment of readiness activities with country AP teams.
 



 • Validate user preparedness and operational readiness before deployment.
 



 • Support business go\-live activities and the transition into production operations.
 



  





**5\. Hypercare \& Stabilization** 




 • Act as an AP User during go\-live and hyper\-care activities.
 



 • Support issue identification, investigation, prioritization, escalation, and resolution.
 



 • Monitor user adoption, operational effectiveness, exception trends, and process performance. • Support the transition from project deployment to steady\-state AP ownership and operations. • Validate that AP teams are fully prepared to own and sustain future\-state processes.
 



  





**6\. AP Operations \& Continuous Improvement** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve process effectiveness, user experience, controls, and operational efficiency.
 



 • Capture lessons learned and support continuous improvement activities for future deployment waves.
 



 • Promote the adoption of standardized global processes across countries.
 



 • Support AP adoption of intelligent automation and future AI\-enabled capabilities.
 



 • Provide operational feedback to guide future solution enhancements and country rollouts.
 



  





**On your first day, we'll expect you to have:** 




 • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related discipline.
 



 •
 **5 to 7 years of experience** 
 in Accounts Payable, Procure\-to\-Pay, Shared Services, Finance Operations, or AP transformation initiatives.
 



 • Strong understanding of invoice processing, approvals, exception management, controls, and payment of readiness processes.
 



 • Experience participating in UAT, deployment, go\-live, hyper\-care, or operational improvement initiatives.
 



 • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple countries.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 • Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
 



 • Experience supporting ERP, invoice processing, workflow, or automation deployments.
 



 • Exposure to intelligent document processing, workflow automation, RPA, or AI\-enabled finance solutions.
 



 • Experience supporting global or multi\-country transformation programs.
 



 • Experience in Shared Services or Global Business Services organizations.
 



  





**Critical Success Factors** 




  





 • Represent AP operational requirements throughout the deployment lifecycle.
 



 • Bring practical AP operational expertise into process reviews, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
 



 • Ensure future\-state processes are operationally sustainable and practical for AP teams.
 



 • Identify operational risks, process gaps, control concerns, and adoption challenges early.
 



 • Support successful UAT, deployment of readiness, go\-live, hyper\-care, and stabilization activities.
 



 • Build credibility with AP users, operational stakeholders, and project teams.
 



 • Drive successful user adoption and transition into steady\-state operations.
 



 • Promote continuous improvement and operational excellence following deployment.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 • AP operational requirements are accurately represented throughout the deployment lifecycle. • Country\-specific business requirements are validated and appropriately incorporated.
 



 • PDDs, requirements, and operational procedures reflect real\-world AP operating needs.
 



 • UAT scenarios cover realistic business activities and exception conditions.
 



 • AP users are prepared for deployment, adoption, and future\-state operations.
 



 • Future\-state processes are operationally sustainable and can be effectively owned and
 



 managed by AP teams after project completion.
 



 • Country deployments achieve successful business adoption with minimal disruption.
 



 • Hypercare activities transition smoothly into stable operations and business ownership.
 



  





**Benefits:** 




  





 At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.
 



  





**Calfus Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** 




 That means we do not discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in professional information services, providing software and content solutions for legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare professionals. Serving clients in over 180 countries with operations in 40\+, the company helps professionals make confident decisions and drive results. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, it employs around 21,000 people worldwide.
   

  

 The Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) is a finance function designed to bring together finance and accounting professionals to streamline and enhance processes and tools. Within FSS, the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune, India, provides centralized financial and analytical support across all Wolters Kluwer divisions. The team, comprising finance professionals and data scientists, focuses on finance reporting harmonization, technology enablement, and reporting and analytics enhancements.
   

  

 In this role, you would support the Financial Shared Services (FSS) team with reporting, budgeting, and forecasting, while driving process improvements and strategic initiatives. You’d collaborate with finance leaders to enhance performance, provide insights across customer lifecycle processes, and develop revenue models to identify risks and opportunities. Additionally, you'd manage financial planning, reporting, and long\-term strategy, with a strong focus on revenue and key performance metrics.
   

  

**SUPERVISORY RELATIONSHIPS**
**Reports To :** 
 Manager, Finance COE
   

  

**Job Qualifications**
**Education :**
* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in finance accounting, or economics or data analytics or 3 years of experience in finance, accounting, or consulting role
* Preferred: Master’s Degree/MBA in finance or CPA, accounting, or economics or data analysis with 2 years of experience in finance, accounting, or consulting role


**Experience :**
* Experience supporting Technology and Development organizations.
* Ability to meet tight deadlines and deliver quality results.


**Technical Skills :**
* Proficient in handling large datasets and data analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas (IF, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS).
* Skilled in financial analysis, forecasting, and business performance modeling.
* Experienced in KPI development, maintenance, and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of ERP systems, experience with Tagetik and Power BI is a plus.
* Financial decision support and reporting, including cash flow, P\&L, and ad hoc reports.
* Expert in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
* Quick to learn and adapt to new systems and tools.
* Routine use of AI\-enabled tools to support analysis, planning, forecasting, and reporting, with emphasis on applying human judgment as the final control point and ensuring data integrity in all outputs.


**Soft Skills :**
* Demonstrates strong attention to detail with problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-motivated, self\-managing and able to work independently.


**Essential Duties**
**Financial Reporting \& Analysis:**
* Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret financial data to support business decision\-making.
* Support month\-end close activities, including preliminary reporting, accurate financial closure, and variance analysis.
* Analyze, track, and report on assigned costs and revenues against planning and forecasting benchmarks.
* Conduct cost\-per\-unit analysis to evaluate and optimize operational expenses.
* Provide insights into key business metrics across multiple functional areas.


**Forecasting \& Budgeting:**
* Lead or assist in corporate forecasting processes, including annual budgeting and long\-range planning.
* Develop and maintain forecast models using historical trends, vendor data, and volume metrics.
* Monitor actuals versus forecasts and identify key variances and trends.


**Revenue \& Volume Management:**
* Analyze and monitor revenue streams across customer segments and product lines.
* Support pricing strategies and identify opportunities for revenue growth.
* Understand volume impacts due to customer behavior and seasonal trends.
* Identify correlations between volume and variable costs, including temporary help and overtime.


**System \& Process Improvement:**
* Assist in financial system transitions by understanding current tools and supporting migration to new platforms.
* Drive efficiencies in data collection and improve spreadsheet structures and update processes.
* Contribute to identifying business unit opportunities and new workflows for performance enhancement.


**Communication \& Professionalism:**
* Communicate effectively across formats and audiences, including high\-level documentation.
* Uphold corporate values, maintain professionalism, and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Execute various ad\-hoc financial and analytical projects as assigned by management.


**Stakeholder Management:**
* Foster positive and professional relationships with all stakeholders in the workplace for effective collaboration and communication.


**Other Duties**
* Proficient in advanced Excel functions (nested IFs, INDEX/MATCH, macros) for large datasets.
* Familiar with Tagetik and Microsoft Access; experience with Power BI/Tableau is a plus.
* Knowledge of statistical tools and techniques such as SAS/R, Python, time series, and regression analysis.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while managing deadlines effectively.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and adaptable to evolving roles and undefined processes.
* Flexible in adjusting communication and detail levels based on audience needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; capable of drafting high\-level documents with precision.


**Travel Requirements**
 Minimal travel might be required.
   

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
 Working from the Kalyani Nagar, Pune office on a hybrid schedule 8 Days a Month (Monday \& Tuesday)
   

  

  

  

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by most people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities and requirements.*
 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

 Strategic FP\&A leader driving enterprise planning, analytics, and GCC capability growth while building strong relationships and influencing global stakeholders to deliver insight\-driven business outcomes.
   

  

 The Sr. Manager – FP\&A will lead Financial Planning \& Analysis within Medline’s Pune Global Capability Center, serving as a strategic finance partner to global (US and international) stakeholders. The role combines enterprise‑wide financial planning, performance management, analytics, and reporting excellence with people leadership and GCC capability building.
   

  

 This position is expected to evolve FP\&A India from a strong delivery engine into a scaled, strategic, insight‑driven finance capability.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 Strategic FP\&A leader driving enterprise planning, analytics, and GCC capability growth while building strong relationships and influencing global stakeholders to deliver insight\-driven business outcomes.
   

  

 The Sr. Manager – FP\&A will lead Financial Planning \& Analysis within Medline’s Pune Global Capability Center, serving as a strategic finance partner to global (US and international) stakeholders. The role combines enterprise‑wide financial planning, performance management, analytics, and reporting excellence with people leadership and GCC capability building.
   

  

 This position is expected to evolve FP\&A India from a strong delivery engine into a scaled, strategic, insight‑driven finance capability.

 Strategic Financial Planning \& Decision Support
   

  

* Lead strategic planning, AOP, and rolling forecasts aligned with enterprise priorities.
* Provide forward‑looking insights, scenario analysis, and risk assessment to support business decisions.


 Financial Analysis, Reporting \& Performance Management
   

  

* Own enterprise monthly management reporting and variance analysis with meaningful business insights.
* Track KPIs and financial trends to identify risks and opportunities.


 Business Partnership
   

  

* Serve as a trusted finance partner to senior leaders, supporting key initiatives and informed trade‑offs through data‑driven insights.


 India GCC Leadership \& Global Delivery
   

  

* Lead FP\&A delivery from the Pune GCC and position the team as a high‑value global finance partner.
* Transition and expand scope of global FP\&A work through standardization and best practices.


 Technology, Analytics \& Process Excellence
   

  

* Strengthen financial modeling, analytics, automation, and FP\&A tools to improve efficiency and insight quality.
* Drive continuous improvement and strong data governance.


 People Leadership \& Capability Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop FP\&A managers and analysts; build capabilities, talent pipeline and high‑performance culture.


 Governance \& Control
   

  

* Ensure accuracy, timeliness, compliance, and adherence to internal controls and ethical standards.


**Leadership Expectations**
* Operate with a global, enterprise mindset
* Build influence through credibility, insights, and people leadership
* Transition FP\&A India GCC from support function to strategic capability engine
* Balance near‑term execution excellence with long‑term capability building


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills
* Strong experience in FP\&A at an offshore GCC
* Strong finance and accounting fundamentals with business acumen
* Strategic thinking with ability to link business events to financial impact and risk

 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.

We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.

With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.

title: Principal, Capital Planning & Portfolio Lead, Infrastructure Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Principal Technology Portfolio Lead is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, forecasting, governance, optimization, and financial management of the organization's technology portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Technology Services.
   

  

 This role serves as the critical bridge between Technology Leadership, Finance, Vendor Management, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to ensure effective management of both Capital (CapEx) and Operating Expenses (OpEx). The individual will drive financial transparency, portfolio optimization, investment prioritization, cost efficiency initiatives, and long\-range technology financial planning.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with deep understanding of technology domains including cloud computing, infrastructure, applications, software engineering, software licensing, hardware lifecycle management, data center services, and managed services. They must possess the ability to influence senior leaders and drive strategic decisions through data\-driven insights and innovative financial management practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Portfolio Financial Management**
* Own and manage the end\-to\-end technology financial portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Services.
* Lead annual budget planning, quarterly forecasting, monthly financial reviews, and multi\-year strategic financial planning processes.
* Develop and maintain technology investment roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise technology strategies.
* Create financial models to support investment decisions, business cases, technology transformations, and modernization initiatives.
* Partner with technology executives to optimize allocation of technology spend and resources across strategic priorities.


**CapEx and OpEx Governance**
* Establish governance frameworks for technology capital and operating expenditures.
* Monitor portfolio performance against approved budgets and forecasts.
* Drive financial accountability among portfolio owners and technology leaders.
* Provide variance analysis, trend reporting, risk assessments, and remediation plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate financial controls, capitalization policies, and audit requirements.


**Cloud and Infrastructure Financial Optimization**
* Lead cloud financial management (FinOps) practices across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Drive optimization of cloud consumption, reserved instances, licensing utilization, and infrastructure costs.
* Analyze technology spending patterns across compute, storage, networking, SaaS, platform services, and managed services.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities while maintaining service quality and operational resilience.
* Support technology modernization initiatives with robust financial analysis and return\-on\-investment assessments.


**Hardware, Software and Licensing Management**
* Develop strategic plans for hardware refresh cycles, infrastructure modernization, and asset lifecycle management.
* Partner with Procurement and Vendor Management teams to optimize software contracts and licensing strategies.
* Monitor software license utilization and ensure cost\-effective licensing models.
* Evaluate vendor proposals, renewals, and technology investments from a financial and business value perspective.
* Drive enterprise\-wide software rationalization and optimization programs.


**Strategic Planning and Technology Investments**
* Facilitate investment prioritization across competing technology initiatives.
* Support executive governance forums responsible for portfolio review and investment approvals.
* Build executive\-level dashboards and KPI frameworks to measure portfolio performance.
* Develop scenario planning and financial forecasting models to support strategic technology decisions.
* Provide recommendations to optimize technology ROI and business outcomes.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, Technology Executives, Finance Leaders, and Business Partners.
* Collaborate with PMOs, Engineering Leaders, Infrastructure Teams, Cloud Teams, Application Leaders, Procurement, and Finance functions.
* Present financial insights, recommendations, and portfolio performance updates to senior leadership.
* Drive alignment between technology strategy, financial objectives, and enterprise priorities.


**Process Improvement and Automation**
* Modernize technology financial management practices through automation and analytics.
* Drive adoption of portfolio management and financial governance tools.
* Implement data\-driven reporting, forecasting, and planning capabilities.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytics platforms to improve forecasting accuracy and financial decision\-making.
* Champion continuous improvement across portfolio governance and financial operations.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in technology portfolio management, technology finance, strategic planning, PMO leadership, or technology operations.
* 5\+ years managing large\-scale technology budgets and investment portfolios exceeding $50M\+ annually.
* Strong experience managing both CapEx and OpEx within enterprise technology organizations.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior technology and finance executives.
* Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business case development skills.
* Strong understanding of technology cost structures across infrastructure, cloud, applications, software engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise platforms.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, CPA, PMP, PgMP, or equivalent professional certification.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Asset Management, Insurance, or highly regulated industries.

title: Alternative Ops Derivatives & Collateral Management, Associate 2
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
 Derivative SMEs are primarily responsible for the timely and accurate execution and reporting of derivative processing that impacts net asset valuations (NAVs) for our clients’ accounts (funds).
   

  

****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
   

  

 Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
 As a derivative SME, you are primarily responsible for the timely and accurate execution and reporting derivative activities that impact to net asset valuations (NAVs) for our clients’ accounts (funds). The derivative SME identifies, analyzes and substantiates impacts of derivatives to the NAV. Critical functions performed include the processing of and verification of all derivative activities and reflecting the same in system to be captured by downstream teams, assisting in addressing derivative queries and participating in various programs with derivatives requirement. This could extend to assist in data analysis, test performing and various new products onboarding, etc.
   

  

 What we value. The derivative SME possess strong risk awareness to verify potential NAV impacts issue including MTM movement, position checking and accrual verifications. This could extend to engage with various parties to deal with potential queries and verification of trades and cash items to ensure the integrity of the NAV. Sprits of self\-determination and investigation are required.

* Validate and review all daily operational activities related to the CFD Reconciliation process while maintaining all required controls.
* Investigate Position, Dividend, Gain and Loss breaks, identify the root cause, and resolve the breaks.

* Research and resolve exceptions, reconciliations, incorrect transactions, and issues.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite

* Strong working knowledge of Bloomberg and any other market Vendor.

* Team player who is diligent, Attention to detail\-oriented, organized.
* Candidate must exhibit high degree of accuracy and the ability to meet deadlines


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications:****
* Degree in Commerce, Finance or MBA with relevant specialization
* Any Certification in Financial Markets will be considered a plus

 State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. title: Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) \& Cyber Security
   

  

**Job Description**
**Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) \& Cyber Security \| Pune \| Full\-time**
 Vanderlande is seeking a proactive and analytical Supplier Risk \& Due Diligence Analyst (ESG \& Cyber Security) to support the global Supplier Sustainability \& Risk function within Procurement.
   

  

 As part of Vanderlande’s global procurement organization, you will play a key role in assessing supplier risks and ensuring our supply base operates in line with sustainability, compliance, and cyber security expectations. You will contribute to a resilient, responsible, and future\-proof supplier ecosystem by supporting supplier due diligence, ESG assessments, third\-party cyber security reviews, and ongoing supplier risk monitoring.
   

  

 Our global procurement organization enables projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the procurement of goods and services in a smart, cost\-effective, sustainable, and secure way.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a Supplier Risk \& Due Diligence Analyst, you will support supplier qualification, onboarding, monitoring, reassessment, and remediation activities across multiple risk dimensions. You will work closely with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, business stakeholders, and suppliers to evaluate and manage supplier\-related risks throughout the supplier lifecycle and support risk management activities embedded within Vanderlande's Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes.
   

  

 A key part of the role will be supporting the adoption and operational use of supplier risk and cyber security monitoring tools, including BitSight or other approved risk intelligence platforms, to assess third\-party cyber exposure, identify risk indicators, and support timely follow\-up actions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support execution of supplier due diligence activities as part of supplier onboarding, qualification, periodic reassessment, and ongoing monitoring processes.
* Conduct supplier risk assessments across ESG, cyber security, information security, financial stability, compliance, geopolitical, operational, and business continuity risk dimensions.
* Review supplier information, responses, supporting documentation, certifications, policies, and evidence to validate due diligence outcomes and identify potential risk indicators and information gaps.
* Review supplier cyber security documentation, including security questionnaires, ISO 27001 certifications, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy indicators, business continuity documentation, and third\-party cyber risk ratings.
* Support the implementation and operational use of BitSight or similar approved cyber risk intelligence platforms, including supplier monitoring, cyber risk score analysis, follow\-up of identified risk indicators, and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier risk intelligence sources and identify emerging risks requiring escalation, mitigation, reassessment, or stakeholder review.
* Analyze supplier risk data and prepare clear insights, dashboards, reports, and management updates for procurement and governance forums.
* Review supplier documentation and due diligence evidence against established responsible sourcing, sustainability, compliance, and governance requirements, highlighting potential concerns and coordinating follow\-up with relevant stakeholders
* Coordinate remediation activities with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, documented, and followed up within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate supplier risk records, assessment outcomes, documentation, dashboards, and reporting within approved systems and tools.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, IT, and business teams to ensure an integrated supplier risk management approach.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of supplier due diligence, ESG, risk, and cyber security assessment processes, templates, tools, and governance routines.
* Ensure all activities are executed in compliance with company policies, governance standards, confidentiality requirements, and regulatory expectations.


**What You Bring**
 To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical thinking, operational discipline, stakeholder collaboration, and risk awareness. You are comfortable working in a dynamic global environment and can translate supplier risk data into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

 You should bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Sustainability, Risk Management, Information Security, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in supplier risk management, due diligence, procurement, sustainability, compliance, cyber security, audit, or a related field.
* Good understanding of supplier lifecycle management, third\-party risk management, supplier onboarding, and supplier reassessment processes.
* Knowledge of ESG frameworks, responsible sourcing practices, sustainability regulations, and supply chain due diligence expectations.
* Understanding of cyber security and information security concepts, including third\-party cyber risk, information security controls, ISO 27001, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy, GDPR, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with supplier risk, due diligence, compliance, ESG, or cyber risk monitoring platforms. Experience with BitSight or similar cyber risk intelligence platforms is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and other data analysis or reporting tools.
* Ability to assess supplier documentation, identify gaps, and translate findings into clear risk summaries and follow\-up actions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across procurement, suppliers, technical teams, and global stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Curiosity, continuous learning mindset, and willingness to adapt to evolving regulations, risk landscapes, and digital tools.
* Business fluency in English.


**About Vanderlande**
 Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check\-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
   

  

 At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Website** 
 www.vanderlande.com
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
   

  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro\-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work\-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.


**How We Work**
 We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
   

  

**Ready to apply?**
 Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
   

  

**Diversity \& inclusion**
 Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.
