title: Accountant
description:
Job Description – Accountant / Accounts Executive
 



**Company:** 
 DigiHelic Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



  





 About DigiHelic
 



 DigiHelic Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an IT services and technology company providing SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, software development, IT staffing, and AI\-powered technology solutions to clients in India and international markets.
 



  





 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and responsible
 **Accountant / Accounts Executive** 
 to manage day\-to\-day accounting activities and support statutory compliance, financial reporting, billing, collections, and other finance\-related operations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Day\-to\-Day Accounting
 


* Maintain books of accounts and ensure timely and accurate accounting entries.
* Record sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, payments, journal entries, and bank transactions.
* Maintain proper documentation and supporting records for all financial transactions.
* Perform ledger scrutiny and reconciliation.
* Ensure proper accounting of domestic and international transactions.



 2\. Accounts Receivable \& Payable
 


* Prepare and issue customer invoices and credit/debit notes.
* Track outstanding receivables and follow up with customers for timely payments.
* Maintain vendor accounts and process vendor invoices and payments.
* Prepare ageing reports for receivables and payables.
* Coordinate with internal teams for billing and payment\-related queries.



 3\. GST \& TDS
 


* Assist in preparation and filing of GST returns and related reconciliations.
* Verify GST applicability and correctness of GST on invoices.
* Prepare and maintain TDS workings and support timely TDS payments and returns.
* Reconcile GST/TDS records with books and government portals.
* Coordinate with the CA/tax consultant for statutory compliance and assessments.



 4\. Banking \& Reconciliation
 


* Record and reconcile bank transactions on a regular basis.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliation.
* Monitor incoming customer payments and outgoing vendor payments.
* Prepare payment instructions and supporting documents as required.
* Maintain proper records of bank\-related transactions.



 5\. Payroll \& Employee\-Related Accounting
 


* Support monthly payroll processing and salary\-related accounting.
* Maintain employee reimbursement and expense records.
* Coordinate for salary deductions, TDS and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain records of employee advances and settlements.



 6\. International Transactions
 


* Maintain accounting records for international invoices, receipts and payments.
* Handle foreign currency transactions and related accounting entries.
* Support documentation for international remittances and banking transactions.
* Coordinate with management and consultants for applicable foreign exchange and tax documentation.



 7\. Financial Reporting \& Management Support
 


* Prepare monthly MIS reports and financial summaries.
* Assist in preparation of Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet and other financial reports.
* Provide receivables, payables, cash flow and expense reports to management.
* Identify accounting discrepancies and ensure timely correction.
* Support budgeting, cash\-flow planning and other finance\-related analysis.



 8\. Audit \& Compliance Support
 


* Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants and CA.
* Provide required schedules, ledgers, invoices and supporting documents for audits.
* Maintain proper records for statutory and internal audits.
* Ensure finance\-related documentation is complete and readily accessible.



 Required Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
* Good working knowledge of
 **GST, TDS and Indian taxation basics** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Tally Prime / accounting ERP or similar accounting software** 
 .
* Good knowledge of
 **MS Excel** 
 , including formulas, filters, Pivot Tables and reconciliation.
* Strong understanding of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Good banking and bank reconciliation experience.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial information.
* Good communication and coordination skills.



  





 Preferred Experience
 



 Candidates with experience in an
 **IT services / software / consulting / staffing company** 
 will be preferred.
 



  





 Experience handling
 **international clients, foreign currency transactions, export of services, GST and related documentation** 
 will be an added advantage.
 



 Qualifications
 


* B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / equivalent qualification.
* 2–5 years of relevant accounting experience.



 Key Attributes
 


* Accuracy and attention to detail
* Ownership and accountability
* Good follow\-up skills
* Ability to meet statutory and financial deadlines
* Professional and ethical approach
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



  





 What You Will Work On
 



 The role will provide exposure to the complete finance and accounting cycle of a growing technology company, including:
 



**Accounting → Billing → Receivables → Payables → Banking → GST/TDS → Payroll Support → International Transactions → MIS → Audit \& Compliance** 




 Salary
 



**As per experience and industry standards.**

 Internal process

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Manages a team of accounting professionals, guiding them to deliver accurate and timely financial services while meeting client SLAs and organizational objectives. Responsible for setting team goals, conducting performance reviews, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth. This role ensures the team is well\-resourced, equipped with the necessary tools and skills, and positioned to deliver high\-quality results. Additionally, the Manager implements controls and drives process improvements, contributing to operational efficiency and client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Result Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of accounting professionals, setting clear performance goals and providing regular feedback. Cultivate a culture of growth, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations, offering constructive feedback, coaching, and development plans to support team members in reaching their professional potential.
* Ensure the team is adequately resourced and equipped with the necessary tools, skills, and support to meet client and organizational standards. Identify and address training needs, facilitating skills development to enhance team performance.
* Establish and maintain strong control frameworks and review processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timeliness of all financial deliverables.
* Oversee the preparation of audit schedules, ensure the team provides required documentation to auditors, and coordinate audit responses to maintain transparency and compliance.
* Analyze current processes, identify opportunities for efficiency, and lead initiatives to drive process improvements and transformation, ensuring alignment with organizational best practices.
* Monitor and manage adherence to SLAs, implementing corrective actions as needed to meet quality and timeline expectations.
* Oversee the preparation, validation, and reconciliation of financial statements and reports. Ensure discrepancies are identified and resolved, and reports are accurate and delivered on time.
* Represent the team in cross\-functional forums, maintaining open communication with stakeholders and addressing any issues or escalations. Conduct periodic reviews to ensure alignment on objectives and performance updates.
* Utilize knowledge of working capital management to optimize receivables, payables, and cash flow, supporting the financial health of the business.


**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Advanced Excel is a must) and any accounting software


**Work Experience**
* 12\+ years of accounting experience, with a minimum of 5 years in a supervisory or managerial role within a BPO or shared services environment.
* Strong expertise in accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliation, and working capital management.
* Excellent leadership, organizational, and delegation skills, with a proven ability to develop and motivate a high\-performing team.
* Experience establishing and enhancing control frameworks, conducting performance evaluations, and implementing process improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to meet and manage SLAs and take proactive corrective actions when necessary.
* Strong skills in stakeholder management, with a track record of effective communication in high\-paced environments.
* Familiarity with international accounting standards and BPO\-specific client requirements.

* Effective communicator with excellent problem\-solving, coordination and follow\-through skills

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to influence Finance Services delivery and governance across multiple international markets
* Exposure to senior Finance Services leadership, Service Line Leads, FP\&A teams, Chief Accountants and market finance stakeholders
* Ability to shape and embed a key element of the post\-NOVA operating model
* Broad visibility across finance operations, transformation initiatives and shared services governance activities
* Opportunity to drive service improvements, stakeholder confidence and operational effectiveness at scale

**Role**

In addition, this individual will also work closely with various stakeholders to ensure ongoing escalation of implementation and compliance concerns. **Principal Responsibilities**

This includes creation and maintenance of the data map, establishing data dictionary, and aligning standards across 1LOD and 2LOD

* Review and Challenge: Respond to the 2LOD review and challenge requests
* Identify and escalate situations that include complex challenges and articulate actionable plans to drive results, while demonstrating exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
* Demonstrate experience in reviewing and interpreting deliverables, providing recommendations, and taking initiative on projects or team tasks, while managing multiple priorities effectively and driving outcomes independently
* Assist in the transformation and change across a global organization in line with a defined project timeline, particularly in enhancing processes and controls supporting issues and control reporting
* Perform thematic read\-across to identify enterprise trends and opportunities, formulating remediation plans and ownership to address.


**Skills / Experience**

* Strong communication written/oral skills, ability to communicate complex topics in a simple and concise manner
* Proficient in Excel and PowerBI, and other business applications
* Experience using ServiceNow is strongly desired

title: Planning Manager
description:
**About the role** 




  





 The Planning Manager will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules across all interior design\-and\-build projects. The role requires close coordination with design, procurement, project execution, vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure project milestones are achieved efficiently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Project Planning \& Scheduling** 




  




* Own and publish comprehensive baseline project schedules for all active design\-and\-build projects, covering design, procurement, execution, and handover phases.
* Develop detailed, activity\-level schedules that clearly identify critical path, dependencies, and float.
* Build master schedules and rolling look\-ahead plans that surface risks and constraints weeks in advance, enabling proactive recovery.
* Maintain and update all schedules as actuals roll in, keeping them alive and credible as the project's source of truth.



  





**2\. Schedule Monitoring \& Control** 




  




* Track actual progress against planned schedules on a weekly basis; flag delays, acceleration, and deviations immediately.
* Conduct detailed variance analysis, dig into the why behind every slip: is it design approval, procurement, execution, or resource constraints?
* Produce weekly project status reports and monthly scheduling reviews for management; articulate impact on project delivery dates and cost implications.
* Ensure zero misses on timelines, hold the line on milestones and escalate deviations that threaten delivery.



  





**3\. Risk \& Recovery Management** 




  




* Proactively identify schedule\-related risks, design delays, vendor lead times, resource constraints, site conditions, and develop clear mitigation strategies.
* Monitor inter\-dependencies between projects and functions to flag conflicts and resource contention early.



  





**4\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




  




* Partner closely with Design, Procurement, Execution, and Site teams to understand realistic timelines, identify bottlenecks, and drive schedule alignment.
* Facilitate monthly planning review meetings and weekly progress tracking calls; be the voice for timeline realism and early warning.
* Work with vendors, subcontractors, and suppliers to understand delivery windows and manage external dependencies.
* Support client communication on project timelines, change impact, and schedule recovery plans.



  





**5\. Planning Tools \& Analytics** 




  




* Maintain accurate project records, schedule baselines, change logs, ensuring data integrity and traceability.
* Spot trends and anomalies: unusual delays, recurring bottlenecks, missed forecasts, and bring structured recommendations to close them.



  





**Academic \& Professional Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Project Planning certifications are a strong advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls, not just project support.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously in design\-and\-build, commercial interiors or workplace fit\-outs.
* Prior exposure to investor\-facing or stakeholder reporting roles is valued.



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Deep, confident command of MS Project.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, dashboards, pivot analysis, data visualization, and dynamic reporting.
* Experience building project dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
* Familiarity with construction methodologies, interior fit\-out processes, and project lifecycle management.

title: Accounting Process & Consolidation Subject Matter Expert
description:
Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an Accounting Process \& Consolidation Subject Matter Expert (SME) with strong hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end accounting processes, financial close, consolidation, and financial reporting.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have practical experience across key finance and accounting cycles such as Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Record\-to\-Report (R2R), General Ledger (GL), Intercompany Accounting, Financial Close, Consolidation, and Financial Reporting, along with a working understanding of Internal Audit, ICFR, financial controls, and compliance requirements.
 



 This role is designed for professionals who are interested in working at the intersection of Accounting, Finance Transformation, Controls, Process Improvement, and Technology. The candidate will work closely with clients, product teams, and developers to understand existing finance processes and translate practical accounting requirements into scalable technology\-driven solutions.
 



 The role requires a proactive and adaptable individual who is comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment and across multiple areas of accounting, finance, audit, controls, and technology.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. End\-to\-End Accounting Process Understanding
 


* Understand and analyze clients' end\-to\-end accounting and finance processes, including:
* Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
* Order\-to\-Cash (O2C)
* Record\-to\-Report (R2R)
* General Ledger Accounting
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Fixed Assets
* Inventory Accounting
* Bank and Account Reconciliations
* Intercompany Accounting
* Financial Close
* Consolidation
* Financial Reporting
* Understand transaction flows from source documents and sub\-ledgers through the General Ledger and ultimately into consolidated financial statements.
* Identify process gaps, accounting issues, manual activities, reconciliation challenges, control weaknesses, and opportunities for automation.



 2\. Financial Close \& Consolidation
 


* Understand and contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes.
* Review and understand entity\-level trial balances and consolidation requirements.
* Support processes relating to:
* Trial balance validation
* Period\-end journal entries
* Accruals and provisions
* Prepayments
* Account reconciliations
* Intercompany reconciliations
* Intercompany eliminations
* Foreign currency translation
* Consolidation adjustments
* Reclassification entries
* Top\-side adjustments
* Consolidation of subsidiaries and reporting entities
* Preparation and review of consolidated financial statements
* Understand dependencies between operational accounting processes and the financial close and consolidation process.



 3\. Accounting \& Financial Reporting
 


* Apply practical knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting requirements while designing accounting solutions.
* Understand accounting treatment and reporting implications of transactions across different finance processes.
* Analyze the impact of accounting transactions on the Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and related financial reporting.
* Support the design of accounting rules, journal\-entry logic, reconciliation logic, and reporting requirements within finance technology solutions.
* Contribute to solutions involving automated accounting, financial close, consolidation, reconciliations, and financial reporting.



 4\. Finance Process Transformation \& Documentation
 


* Understand clients' As\-Is finance and accounting processes and identify opportunities for standardization, optimization, and automation.
* Design and document To\-Be processes incorporating accounting requirements, controls, automation, and technology.
* Prepare detailed:
* Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Functional Requirement Documents
* Process Flow Diagrams
* Accounting Workflows
* User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Business Rules
* Accounting Rules and Validation Logic
* Reconciliation and Exception\-Handling Workflows
* Translate practical finance and accounting requirements into clear functional requirements for product and development teams.



 5\. Audit, ICFR \& Controls
 


* Apply a working understanding of Internal Audit, ICFR, financial controls, and risk assessment while designing accounting processes and solutions.
* Identify key financial reporting risks and relevant controls within processes such as P2P, O2C, R2R, financial close, and consolidation.
* Understand concepts including:
* Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs)
* Process\-Level Controls
* Entity\-Level Controls
* Preventive and Detective Controls
* Manual and Automated Controls
* Segregation of Duties
* Management Review Controls
* Reconciliation Controls
* IT\-Dependent Controls
* Support the design of accounting solutions that maintain appropriate audit trails, approvals, evidence, access controls, and financial reporting controls.
* Collaborate with audit and compliance teams where accounting processes or product functionality impact ICFR or financial reporting controls.



 6\. Product \& Technology Collaboration
 


* Act as a bridge between Accounting/Finance teams and Product/Technology teams.
* Translate complex accounting and finance requirements into functional requirements that can be understood and implemented by developers.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and client stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Contribute accounting expertise to the design of AI\-driven and automation\-based finance solutions.
* Participate in solution design discussions and validate whether proposed functionality appropriately addresses accounting and business requirements.



 7\. Product Testing \& UAT
 


* Develop accounting and business scenarios for product testing.
* Perform functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of accounting and finance solutions.
* Validate:
* Accounting calculations
* Journal entries
* Posting logic
* Reconciliation logic
* Matching logic
* Exception handling
* Approval workflows
* Consolidation logic
* Financial reporting outputs
* Identify functional gaps and work with development teams to resolve issues before deployment.



 8\. Client Implementation \& Support
 


* Participate in client discussions to understand existing finance processes, systems, accounting requirements, and pain points.
* Support deployment and implementation of accounting and finance solutions within client environments.
* Assist with process mapping, configuration requirements, testing, data validation, and implementation.
* Provide user training and functional guidance to finance and accounting teams.
* Support post\-deployment activities and identify opportunities for continuous process and product improvement.



  





  





 Candidate Profile
 



 Qualifications
 


* Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred.
* MBA Finance, CMA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent finance/accounting qualifications may also be considered depending on relevant experience.
* Additional certifications in Finance Transformation, ERP, Internal Audit, CISA, or related areas are an advantage.
* Big 4, consulting, shared services, Global Capability Center (GCC), or large corporate finance experience is preferred.



 Experience
 


* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in Accounting, Financial Reporting, Financial Close, Consolidation, Finance Transformation, or related finance functions.
* Practical exposure to one or more end\-to\-end finance processes such as:
* P2P
* O2C
* R2R
* General Ledger
* Intercompany Accounting
* Financial Close
* Consolidation
* Financial Reporting
* Experience in month\-end, quarter\-end, and/or year\-end close activities is preferred.
* Exposure to Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, ICFR/SOX, or financial controls is an added advantage.
* Experience working with finance technology, ERP systems, automation, or finance transformation projects is preferred.



  





 Skills Required
 



 Accounting \& Finance
 


* Strong understanding of double\-entry accounting, General Ledger, Trial Balance, and financial statements.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end accounting cycles and their impact on financial reporting.
* Practical knowledge of financial close, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, consolidation, and reporting.
* Understanding of accounting standards such as Ind AS, IFRS, and/or US GAAP is preferred.



 Process Knowledge
 


* Ability to understand and document complete finance processes from transaction initiation through accounting, reconciliation, close, consolidation, and reporting.
* Ability to identify process inefficiencies, accounting risks, control gaps, and automation opportunities.
* Experience creating As\-Is and To\-Be process flows and detailed accounting workflows.



 Audit \& Controls
 


* Working knowledge of Internal Audit, ICFR/SOX, risk assessment, financial controls, and control testing.
* Ability to understand how accounting processes, controls, and system functionality collectively support reliable financial reporting.



 Technology \& Transformation
 


* Experience preparing BRDs, functional requirements, process documentation, user stories, workflows, and UAT scenarios.
* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Exposure to financial close, consolidation, reconciliation, workflow automation, RPA, analytics, or AI\-based finance solutions is an advantage.
* Ability to translate accounting requirements into clear functional requirements for technology teams.



 Analytical \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to analyze complex accounting and process scenarios and convert them into structured solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with CFO teams, Controllers, Finance Managers, Accountants, Auditors, Product Managers, and Developers.
* Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.



 Startup \& Innovation Mindset
 


* Comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment with evolving responsibilities.
* Willingness to work across accounting, audit, controls, finance transformation, product development, testing, and implementation activities.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive requirements from business problem identification through solution design, testing, and implementation.
* Interest in leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to transform traditional finance and accounting processes.

title: Deal Analyst
description:
About the job
 



  





**Get to know us better** 




 We are Gera Developments Private Limited (GDPL), a brand known by our five\-decade history as one of the pioneers in the Real Estate business in Pune. Innovation, transparency, and enhanced customer experience is how we have created award\-winning, premium residential and commercial projects in Pune, Goa, Bengaluru, and California. We live and work by “Let’s Outdo”, a philosophy that defines everything we do to raise the standards of Real Estate in the country.
 



 There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5\-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017\. We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 To support the land acquisition team in screening, analysing, and tracking real estate transactions from lead stage to decision stage, with strong focus on development potential, underwriting accuracy, regulatory diligence, and management\-note preparation.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Evaluate land, redevelopment, JV/JDA, DM, and plotted development opportunities from first cut to management recommendation.
 



 • Prepare detailed area and yield workings covering plot area, deductions, FSI/TDR/premium FSI, ancillary areas, parking, amenities, carpet, built\-up, and saleable area assumptions.
 



 • Build and update financial models covering land cost, deal structure, approval costs, construction cost, revenue, taxes, cash flows, sensitivities, margin, and IRR.
 



 • Review title, sanction, DP, zoning, road width, access, reservation, TOD / IT\-ITES / local regulation applicability, and other diligence inputs with internal and external teams.
 



 • Prepare Go / No\-Go notes, transaction snapshots, risk registers, assumption trackers, meeting notes, and board / management discussion material.
 



 • Coordinate with Sales, Design, Liaison, Legal, Finance, Records, consultants, brokers, and landowners to close data gaps and move transactions forward.
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 • Background in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Planning, Commerce, Finance, Real Estate, or Management; MBA / PGDM / Masters preferred but not mandatory.
 



 • Strong comfort with Excel, financial modelling, area statements, document structuring, and transaction analysis in residential / commercial / redevelopment projects.
 



 • Ability to spot data gaps, challenge weak assumptions, maintain version discipline, and work accurately under fast deal timelines.
 



 • Clear written communication, structured thinking, and confidence in converting scattered inputs into clean, decision\-ready outputs.
 



  





**TOOLS / SUCCESS MEASURES** 




 • Strong Excel and PowerPoint are mandatory; working familiarity with Google Earth / GIS, AutoCAD / drawings, and document trackers is desirable.
 



 • Success will be measured by quality of underwriting.

description:

The attractive combination of high\-value consulting services with a competitively priced remote development team has proven to be successful in projects worldwide. With a solid growth, currently 450\+ Evorians are working in offices in India, US, Brazil, Germany, Austria and Spain.
   

  

 As a trusted partner for data\-driven transformation, we help enterprise customers design, build, and operate modern data platforms, business intelligence solutions, and AI\-powered applications across the Microsoft ecosystem. Our team of experienced consultants and engineers delivers end\-to\-end solutions spanning Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Power BI, Azure AI Foundry, and Power Platform. With a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and customer proximity, Evora (Connect) combines deep technical expertise with strategic advisory to empower organisations on their digital journey.
   

  

**About Evora IT Solutions \& Evora Service Partner**
 Evora IT Solutions Group is a global SAP partner delivering innovative IT services and solutions. As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing the Evora Service Partner Centre (“Evora Service Partner”) — an unified, centralised function supporting all Evora entities globally under a single operating model. Phase 1 of Evora Service Partner will serve our Germany and USA entities, with a clear expansion roadmap to additional regions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Finance Lead – Evora Service Partner is a senior individual contributor and team lead role based in India, forming part of Evora Group's shared finance delivery model. The role sits within the Evora Service Partner (ESP) organisation in India and operates as a dedicated finance function supporting Evora Group's global entities.
   

  

 You will lead a team of finance professionals in India who provide shared finance services — including general ledger accounting, financial reporting, and process operations — to Evora Group entities globally. While your day\-to\-day employment and people management are with the ESP Head in India, your finance work is directed by and closely aligned with the Global Finance Lead, ensuring full integration with Evora Group's global finance function.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role for a finance professional who combines technical depth in accounting with a service\-delivery mindset, the ability to build trusted cross\-cultural working relationships, and the drive to lead a team delivering excellence from India to the world.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in accounting/finance, with strong exposure to multi\-entity international environments.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a team lead or managerial capacity within a Shared Services Centre (SSC).
* Strong expertise in accounting standards: IFRS and HGB; local GAAP knowledge a plus.
* Deep understanding of month\-end close, balance sheet management, and consolidated financial reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP (S/4HANA or SAP Cloud ERP an advantage).
* Proven track record collaborating with senior global stakeholders and cross\-border teams.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* Fluent English (written and spoken) essential; German language skills a strong advantage.
* Practical experience applying AI tools in a finance or shared services context.
* Proven ability to coach teams on new ways of working; comfortable as an informal AI champion.
* Grounded understanding of responsible AI use: data sensitivity, compliance boundaries, and appropriate human oversight.


**What You Bring**
**Shared Finance Service Delivery**
* Lead the delivery of high\-quality, SLA\-driven finance services from the India team to Evora Group global entities.
* Ensure all deliverables — reporting, reconciliations, close activities — are completed accurately, on time, and to the standard set by the Global Finance Lead.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the India\-based finance team and the global finance function.
* Monitor service quality, proactively flag issues, and drive resolution in coordination with the Global Finance Lead.


**General Ledger Ownership \& Accounting Excellence**
* End\-to\-end ownership of GL processes for Evora Group international entities supported from India.
* Ensure accurate and timely month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close (HGB, IFRS, applicable local GAAPs).
* Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Drive strong accounting practices across AP, AR, fixed assets, and intercompany accounting.
* Maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and ongoing audit readiness across all entities served.


**Financial Reporting \& Compliance**
* Prepare and review financial statements in line with HGB, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.
* Support group consolidation and reporting processes in close collaboration with the Global Finance Lead.
* Act as a key liaison for internal and external audits across entities served from India.
* Ensure compliance with tax, regulatory, and governance requirements across jurisdictions.


**Team Leadership within the Shared Service Model**
* Lead, coordinate, and develop the India\-based finance team delivering global finance services.
* Set clear task priorities and workload plans aligned to global finance calendars and deadlines.
* Foster a high\-quality, service\-oriented team culture focused on accuracy, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
* Support team capability development in coordination with the ESP Head and Global Finance Lead.


**Global Finance Collaboration**
* Work closely and proactively with the Global Finance Lead to receive direction, align on priorities, and report on delivery.
* Collaborate with onshore finance teams (Germany HQ and other regional offices) to ensure seamless, aligned service delivery.
* Provide technical accounting guidance and act as a subject matter expert to global finance stakeholders.
* Participate in global finance meetings, planning cycles, and cross\-entity initiatives as required.


**Process Standardisation, Automation \& Transformation**
* Lead standardisation and harmonisation of finance processes across all entities supported from India.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement in closing, reconciliation, and reporting workflows.
* Actively contribute to group\-wide finance transformation initiatives, including SAP Cloud ERP rollout.
* Ensure data integrity, chart of accounts consistency, and strong data governance across entities.


**Systems \& Technology**
* Champion effective ERP usage (SAP preferred) with focus on GL and accounting modules.
* Support implementation, testing, and optimisation of finance tools and platforms.


**AI\-First Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Champion an AI\-first mindset within the India finance team — not as a technology project, but as a fundamental shift in how the team works, delivers, and grows.
* Model and embed AI\-driven ways of working across close, reporting, and reconciliation processes — from automation of routine tasks to AI\-assisted analysis and commentary.
* Coach team members to use AI as a force multiplier: sharpening human judgment rather than replacing it.
* Identify practical AI leverage points that compress cycle times, reduce manual effort, and raise output quality.
* Set clear guardrails: ensure AI usage stays within Evora's compliance and data classification policies, and that human accountability is maintained where it matters.
* Stay current on AI developments relevant to finance; bring actionable recommendations to the Global Finance Lead.


**What We Offer**
**Our Values** 
 – Collaboration, Commitment, Evolution, Entrepreneurship, Happiness, and Trust form the foundation of our organization and guide the way we work and grow together.
   

  

**Company Culture** 
 – We foster a collaborative environment where teams work together in integrated virtual teams to serve our customers effectively. We are committed to sharing our success with employees through a strong workplace culture and financial participation.
   

  

**Hybrid Work Model** 
 – We follow a hybrid work culture where employees work from the office twice a week, providing flexibility while encouraging collaboration.
   

  

**Great Place to Work**

 *Great Place to Work* 
 , reflecting our commitment to creating a positive and rewarding workplace.
   

  

**Buddy Program** 
 – As part of our hiring process, new joiners are assigned a buddy who helps them understand the team, technology, and company culture before joining, enabling a smoother transition.
   

  

**Growth \& Learning** 
 – We support continuous learning through training sessions and development programs. Employees also receive access to Udemy for upskilling.
   

  

**Benefits**

title: General Manager/Assistant General Manager - Resort Management at Manori
description:
Role Overview: The General Manager (GM) is responsible for end\-to\-end management of the resort, including administration, day\-to\-day operations, legal and statutory compliance, guest experience, and business growth. The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.
* Set annual and monthly operational targets and monitor performance against KPIs (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction, costs, etc.).



  





 2\. Day\-to\-Day OperationsOversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning of the resort across all shifts.
 


* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.
 


* Ensure compliance with local, state and national laws related to labour, wages, ESI, PF, safety and environmental norms.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, chartered accountants and company secretaries to maintain statutory records and filings.
* Handle inspections, audits and visits from government or regulatory authorities, ensuring full cooperation and zero non\-compliance.



  





 4\. Financial Management and ProfitabilityPrepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts and monthly MIS reports in coordination with Finance.
 


* Track revenue streams (rooms, F\&B, banquets, events, activities, spa, ancillary services) and drive strategies to increase yield and profitability.
* Implement cost\-control measures without compromising guest experience and brand standards.
* Review P\&L statements regularly and recommend corrective actions to management.



  





 5\. Revenue Growth, Sales \& Marketing SupportCollaborate with the sales and marketing team/agency on room packages, events, retreats, weddings, conferences and other offerings to boost occupancy and average rates.
 


* Support digital marketing and OTA strategies (website, social media, Google, booking portals) by providing inputs on promotions, guest stories, visual content and campaigns.
* Build and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporates, event planners and local partners to drive business.
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends and guest feedback to refine pricing and positioning.



  





 6\. Innovation, Business Renovation \& Brand BuildingWork with management to identify and execute innovative, creative ideas to upgrade the resort’s product, services and experiences (e.g., themed experiences, wellness retreats, eco\-friendly initiatives, local cultural programs).
 


* Plan and oversee renovation, refurbishment and modernization projects in coordination with architects, vendors and contractors.
* Introduce new revenue streams (activities, curated experiences, memberships, partnerships, merchandise, etc.) aligned with the brand.
* Ensure the resort aligns with a clear brand story and guest value proposition, and that this is reflected in service, décor, communication and guest interactions.



  




* 7\. Guest Experience and Service QualityEnsure a guest\-centric culture in the resort, with consistent, warm and professional service.
* Personally handle VIP guests, important groups and escalated complaints to ensure quick resolution and delight.
* Monitor guest feedback from all channels (in\-person, feedback forms, online reviews) and convert insights into action plans.
* Implement training and coaching for staff on hospitality standards, communication, grooming and guest handling.



  





 8\. People Leadership \& CultureLead by example and build a high\-performance, accountable, and collaborative culture in the resort.
 


* Oversee recruitment, onboarding and training of staff across levels, in coordination with HR.
* Design and implement staff schedules, performance reviews, rewards and disciplinary actions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, policies on POSH, and a safe, respectful workplace for all employees.



  





 9\. Safety, Security and Risk ManagementEnsure implementation of health, safety and hygiene protocols across the property.
 


* Oversee security arrangements for guests, staff and property assets.
* Develop and periodically review emergency and crisis management plans (fire, medical emergencies, natural disasters, etc.).
* Ensure regular maintenance of all equipment, infrastructure and facilities to minimize breakdowns and risks.



  





 10\. Reporting and Stakeholder ManagementProvide regular updates to promoters/owners on operations, financials, projects and risk areas.
 


* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly performance reports with key insights and recommendations.



 Note: Candidates must have 7\-10 years of experience. Immediate joiners will be preferred. Candidates from Malad, Marve, Vasai, Gorai and Manori locations or nearby areas are encouraged to apply.

title: Accounting and Controls Analyst
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 This position is an Analyst role on the Regional Controller team for the PCS \- CAN Division. An Accounting and Controls Analyst is a professional who plays a crucial role in a company's financial management and internal control processes.Their primary responsibilities involve ensuring accurate financial reporting, maintaining compliance with Accounting standards and regulations, and implementing effective internal Controls to safeguard company assets and prevent fraud.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**

* Internal Controls: Implement and monitor control procedures to minimize the risk of errors, fraud, and financial misstatements. This might involve regularly reviewing and improving internal processes, ensuring proper segregation of duties, and participating in periodic internal audits.
* Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable accounting regulations and reporting requirements. Keep abreast of changes in accounting standards and help the company adapt to new requirements.
* Finance Operations: Support Site Finance Leader actions including all closing and accounting activities.
* Data Analysis: Analyze financial data to identify trends, patterns, and potential issues. This analysis can provide valuable insights into the company's financial health and help management make informed decisions.
* Partnership: Work with and communicate financial information effectively between operations and global support centers. Partner with operations to drive actions discovered through data analysis.
* Process Improvement: Identified opportunities to streamline accounting processes and enhance efficiency. Suggest and implement improvements to reporting methods, financial systems, and automation tools.

 Basic Required Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field
* Minimum of 5 years varied accounting/finance experience

* Advanced Excel skills including Power BI and Tableau

* Experience working with multi\-site environments and work collaboratively across operations, finance and shared service teams.

**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4 \- 5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or in lieu of a degree 6 \-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.

 (WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. description:
Location

**Description \& Requirements**
 Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology \- quickly and accurately. We apply problem\-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes \- all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Company Financials team provides clients with fast and accurate market\-moving data covering broker estimates, financial filings, and other critical datasets that help them assess financial performance. We use financial modeling, industry expertise, data management, and technical skills to curate key metrics and extract insights from our data. Our goal is to deliver a best\-in\-class financial analysis and modeling product while continuously expanding and enhancing our offering.
   

  

 Across Company Financials Data, we are focused on building scalable, observable, and AI\-ready data operations. This includes redesigning workflows, improving process efficiency, embedding automation, and ensuring that financial data is delivered with the quality, consistency, and timeliness our clients expect.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Company Financials Process Automation \& Data Operations team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Management Professional to drive operational excellence across financial data workflows. You will leverage data, automation, and process improvement expertise to optimize production, enhance quality and controls, reduce manual effort, and scale AI\-ready workflows. Partnering with Workflow, Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams, you will deliver solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and client outcomes.
   

  

**We'll Trust You To**
* Analyze workflows and production data to identify bottlenecks, quality risks, and automation opportunities, delivering scalable improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency
* Partner with Workflow, Product, Engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to implement workflow, automation, and operational enhancements
* Build monitoring, reporting, quality control, governance, and exception management frameworks that improve visibility, oversight, and operational resilience
* Perform root cause analysis on production issues and develop sustainable solutions that reduce recurring operational risks
* Leverage SQL, Python, ETL/ELT frameworks, GenAI tools, and automation technologies to optimize data acquisition, transformation, validation, and AI\-ready workflows
* Measure and report on operational performance, automation benefits, and process improvement outcomes
* Act as a subject matter expert and mentor, promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement across the organization


**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or a related STEM field (or equivalent experience)
* 4\+ years of experience in data operations, process improvement, workflow automation, and data governance, including data quality management, metadata management, and operational controls
* Strong technical proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation workflows, and data visualization or workflow monitoring tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI), with knowledge of data observability, data quality monitoring, and production controls
* Experience identifying inefficiencies and delivering measurable improvements through process optimization, automation, monitoring, reporting, and operational performance frameworks
* Experience developing and maintaining production\-grade automation solutions using modern software engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and GenAI\-enabled development tools
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross\-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data teams
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English.


**We'd Love To See**
* Experience working with company financials, financial statements, broker estimates, fundamentals, or capital markets data.
* Familiarity with process improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value stream mapping, or similar frameworks.

title: Vice President – Finance Platforms Application Support Lead
description:
**About M\&G India**
 We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
   

  

 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.
   

  

**About M\&G**
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

 We are looking for a dynamic and strategic leader to take on the role of CFT Finance Platforms Application Support Lead. In this key position, you will provide leadership and oversight to our Accounting Ledgers and Consolidation platform support teams and responsible for end\-to\-end platform ownership, strategic direction, risk ownership, service resilience, external and internal system audits and business\-critical finance outcomes.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in building strong partnerships with stakeholders and collaborating closely with the CFT senior management team to drive meaningful change and continuous service improvement aligned with our business strategy. Your role will also involve working with CFT Portfolio Leads and the Head of CFT Platforms to ensure seamless transitions into service under full governance, while playing a pivotal role in integrating CFT systems across the organization.
   

  

 As VP – Finance Platforms Application Support Lead, the role will be accountable for:
   

  

* Leadership \& Strategic Oversight
* Lead the CFT Finance Systems function, providing direction and oversight to support teams managing platforms such as Oracle Fusion Cloud (Fusion Financials \& Procurement, EPM), Tagetik, AutoRek, Infor SUN, Broadridge Revport, Smartstream TLM, Docusign.
* Ensure teams are right\-sized and aligned with Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) targets in collaboration with the Head of CFT Platforms.
* Drive the adoption of strategic technology solutions in partnership with CFT Portfolio Leads and the Head of CFT Platforms to maximize business value.
* Service Management \& Operational Excellence
* Ensure high\-quality, consistent service and support to CFT stakeholders, meeting business demands and deadlines.
* Conduct regular service reviews with vendors and partners, ensuring KPIs are met and service levels maintained.
* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and audit trails in compliance with internal and external audit requirements.
* Process Automation \& Efficiency
* Collaborate with cross\-functional Technology teams to identify, refine, and implement automated processes that enhance efficiency and add business value.
* Proactively seek opportunities to improve systems, processes, reporting, and data analytics capabilities across the CFT Ledger and Reconciliation platforms.
* Governance, Controls \& Compliance
* Ensure key processes and controls are fully documented, regularly tested, and supported with adequate coverage to guarantee system availability.
* Oversee regression testing and ensure platform functionality is maintained through patching and upgrade cycles.
* Work with external auditors to manage audit pipelines and respond to requests in a timely and compliant manner.
* Change Management \& Continuous Improvement
* Lead system and process improvements, including upgrades to existing products, in collaboration with IT, security teams, and CFT stakeholders.
* Oversee the prioritization and intake process for development work across Ledger, Consolidation, and Reconciliation platforms.
* Ensure future developments are transitioned into service with appropriate team structures and support models in place.
* Development Lifecycle \& Tooling
* Ensure adherence to M\&G’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices across the platform.
* Promote the use of tools such as DevOps and JIRA for version control, requirement traceability, and segregation of duties.
* Subject Matter Expertise \& Business Enablement
* Provide subject matter expertise to CFT portfolio programs to ensure delivery of fit\-for\-purpose business outcomes.
* Act as a key enabler for business transformation by aligning technology capabilities with strategic goals.


 This role offers a unique opportunity to lead a high\-performing support team, work on mission\-critical financial systems, and engage with stakeholders across the enterprise. If you are passionate about Leading a dynamic team, enjoy solving complex functional challenges, and thrive in a leadership role, we invite you to be part of our transformation journey.
   

  

 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A Day in the Life
   

  

 Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state\-of\-the\-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
   

  

 This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.
   

  

 \#BetterDaysStartNow
   

  

**Job Description**
 The MiniMed Corporate Treasury Department manages the company’s cash and investments to ensure adequate liquidity for operating entities around the world, builds and maintains bank relationships, and seeks to reduce the financial risk arising from foreign currency exposures.
   

  

 Treasury works closely with internal stakeholders across finance, accounting, tax, HR, IT, legal and others, as well as external stakeholders including banks, investment firms, and other financial counterparties to achieve its objectives.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled Treasury Analyst to help execute our global treasury operations and help design and build our expanding treasury infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings an understanding of cash management operations and financial risk management with experience in a multinational firm with a global presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Work closely with banks on integrating banking systems with MiniMed financial systems for efficient payment processing and financial reporting.
* Monitor daily cash positions across multiple currencies and legal entities to ensure adequate operational liquidity for our global business.
* Execute wire transfers, intercompany funding, and other cash transfer activities.
* Create BI dashboards to drive actionable insights to inform process improvements and reduce financial risks.
* Identify, track, and analyze FX exposure, and assist in designing FX hedging strategies to mitigate currency risk.
* Perform financial analyses to help drive global treasury decision\-making.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to drive business performance.
* Perform SOX control reporting requirements
* Act as system administrator in bank portals and Treasury systems
* Global bank account administration


**Required Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field of study and experience working in a multinational company
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Ability to develop solutions and/or innovative ideas to problems and ensure that solutions are consistent with the organization’s objectives.
* Ability to interface in a global team environment with various levels of management, staff, and other functional areas
* Strong organizational and people skills with interests in building strong business partnering relationships.


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
   

  

**Benefits \& Compensation**
**MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package**
 At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.
   

  

**About MiniMed**
 We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

title: FS-RC-FSRM - CSTC-FA and R-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
